Dipnot: *1:1 This verse, known as the “Basmalah,” occupies a special position in the Quran. It is the opening statement of every sura, except Sura 9, and it constitutes the foundation upon which the Quran’s 19-based mathematical miracle is built (App. 1). The Basmalah consists of 19 Arabic letters, and its constituent words [Bism Allah Al-Rahman Al-Raheem] occur in the Quran in multiples of 19: 19, 2698, 57, and 114 times, respectively. Thus, the reader is handed at the outset tangible proof that this is not a human-made book. Numerous mathematical phenomena are connected with this verse. For example, the absence of Basmalah from Sura 9 is compensated for 19 suras later; Sura 27 contains two Basmalahs (see Appendix 29 and Footnote 27:30). Thus, the count of all Basmalahs is restored to 114, 19x6. Additionally, when we add the sura numbers from the missing Basmalah (Sura 9) to the extra Basmalah (Sura 27) [9+10+11+.... +27], the total comes to 342, 19x18. This total, remarkably, is also the number of words between the two Basmalahs of Sura 27. As detailed in Appendix 1, the Quran’s mathematical code is so vast, and so intricate that no force on earth could possibly imitate it, let alone manufacture it (17:88).

Dipnot: *2:1 These initials remained a divinely guarded secret for 1400 years. Hundreds of Muslim and Orientalist scholars tried in vain to decipher their significance. Obviously, the Almighty author of the Quran has willed that the decoding of these initials shall be reserved for a specific person, in a specific place, at a specific time (see Appendicies 1, 2, and 26). Now we recognize these initials as a major component of the Quran’s extraordinary mathematical code. The meaning of A.L.M. is pointed out in Verse 2: “This scripture is infallible.” This is incontrovertibly proven by the fact that the frequencies of occurrence of these three initials in this sura are 4502, 3202, and 2195, respectively. The sum of these numbers is 9899, or 19x521. Thus, these most frequent letters of the Arabic language did not suffer any distortion, addition, or loss. These same initials also prefix Suras 3, 29, 30, 31, and 32. Their frequencies of occurrence add up to multiples of 19 in each one of these suras.

Ayet: These are guided by their Lord; these are the winners.
As for those who disbelieved, it is the same for them; whether you warn them, or not warn them, they cannot believe.
GOD has sealed their hearts, and their hearing, and their eyes are veiled. They have incurred severe retribution.
Then there are those who say, “We believe in GOD and the Last Day,” when in fact they are not believers.
In attempting to deceive GOD and those who believed, they only deceive themselves without perceiving.
In their hearts is a disease. Consequently, GOD augments their disease. They have incurred a painful retribution for their lying.
When they are told, “Do not commit evil,” they say, “But we are working righteousness!”
In fact, they are evildoers, but they do not perceive.
When they are told, “Believe as the people have believed,” they say, “Shall we believe as the fools have believed?” In fact, it is they who are fools, but they do not know.
When they meet the believers, they say, “We believe,” but when alone with their devils, they say, “We are still with you; we were only mocking.”
GOD mocks them, by leaving them in their transgressions, blundering.
It is they who bought the straying, at the expense of guidance. Such trade never prospers, nor do they receive any guidance.
Their example is like those who start a fire, then, as it begins to shed light for them, GOD takes away their light, leaving them in darkness, unable to see.
Deaf, dumb, and blind; they fail to return.
Or, like a storm from the sky, with darkness, thunder, and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears, to evade the lightning bolts, and death. GOD thus surrounds the disbelievers.

The lightning almost snatches away their eyesight; whenever it lights for them, they move forward, and when it turns dark, they stand still. If GOD willed, He* could have taken away their hearing and their eyesight. GOD is Omnipotent.

O Children of Israel, remember the favors I bestowed upon you, and that I blessed you more than any other people.
Beware of the day when no soul can avail another, no intercession is accepted, no ransom can be paid, and no one can be helped.
Recall that we saved you from Pharaoh’s people who inflicted the worst persecution upon you, slaying your sons, and sparing your daughters. That was an exacting test from your Lord.
Recall that we parted the sea for you; we thus saved you, and drowned Pharaoh’s people as you looked.
Recall that we summoned Moses for forty nights, then you worshiped the calf in his absence, and you turned wicked.
Yet, we pardoned you thereafter that you may be appreciative.
Recall that we gave Moses the scripture and the statute book, that you may be guided.

Recall that Moses said to his people, “O my people, you have wronged your souls by worshiping the calf. You shall repent to your Creator, and kill your egos. This is better for you, in the sight of your Creator.” He did redeem you, for He is the Redeemer, Most Merciful.
Recall that you said, “O Moses, we will not believe, unless we see GOD, physically.” Consequently, the lightning struck you, as you looked.
Then we resurrected you, after you had died, that you may be appreciative.
We shaded you with clouds, and we sent down to you manna and quails: “Eat from the good things we provided for you.” They never wronged us; they only wronged their own souls.
Recall that we said, “Enter this town, and eat therefrom as you please, generously. Enter the gate humbly, and speak amicably. We will then forgive your sins, and increase the reward for the pious.”
But the wicked among you substituted other words in place of the words given to them. Consequently, we sent down upon the transgressors condemnation from the sky, due to their wickedness.

Recall that Moses sought water for his people, and we said, “Strike the rock with your staff.” Whereupon, twelve springs gushed out therefrom. Thus, each tribe knew their own water: “Eat and drink from GOD’s provisions, and do not roam the earth corruptingly.”

Recall that you said, “O Moses, we can no longer tolerate one kind of food. Call upon your Lord to produce for us such earthly crops as beans, cucumbers, garlic, lentils, and onions.” He said, “Do you wish to substitute that which is inferior for that which is good? Maybe you should go back to Egypt, where you can find what you asked for.” They were condemned to humiliation and disgrace, and they incurred GOD’s wrath. That is because they used to disbelieve in GOD’s revelations, and killed the prophets unjustly. That is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

Ayet: Surely, those who believe, those who are Jewish, the Christians, and the converts; anyone who (1) believes in GOD (2) and the Last Day, and (3) leads a righteous life, will receive their recompense from their Lord. They have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
We made a covenant with you, as we raised Mount Sinai above you: “You shall uphold what we have given you, strongly, and remember what is in it, that you may be saved.”
But you turned away after that! If it were not for GOD’s compassion towards you, and His mercy, you would have been losers.
You have known about those among you who desecrated the Sabbath— we said to them, “Be you despicable apes.”
We rendered them a lesson for their generation, as well as subsequent generations, and an enlightenment for the righteous.
When Moses said to his people, “GOD commands you to sacrifice a heifer,” they said, “Are you mocking us?” He said, “GOD forbid that I should be so ignorant.”

Ayet: Therefore, woe to those who distort the scripture with their own hands, then say, “This is what GOD sent,” seeking a cheap material gain. Woe to them for such distortion, and woe to them for their illicit gains.

They said, “Hell will not touch us, except for a limited number of days.” Say, “Have you taken such a pledge from GOD—and GOD never breaks His promise—or, are you saying about GOD what you do not know?”
Indeed, those who earn evil works, and become surrounded by their sins, will be the dwellers of Hell; they abide therein forever.
As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they will be the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.

We made a covenant with the Children of Israel: You shall not worship except GOD. You shall regard the parents, the relatives, the orphans, and the poor. You shall treat the people amicably. You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). But you turned away, except a few of you, and you became averse.
We made a covenant with you, that you shall not shed your blood, nor evict each other from your homes. You agreed and bore witness.

Yet, here you are killing each other, and evicting some of you from their homes, banding against them sinfully and maliciously. Even when they surrendered, you demanded ransom from them. Evicting them was prohibited for you in the first place. Do you believe in part of the scripture and disbelieve in part? What should be the retribution for those among you who do this, except humiliation in this life, and a far worse retribution on the Day of Resurrection? GOD is never unaware of anything you do.
It is they who bought this life at the expense of the Hereafter. Consequently, the retribution is never commuted for them, nor can they be helped.

We gave Moses the scripture, and subsequent to him we sent messengers. And we gave Jesus, the son of Mary, profound miracles, and supported him with the Holy Spirit. Is it not a fact that whenever a messenger went to you with anything you did not like, you turned arrogant, and either rejected him, or killed him?
They even said, “Our minds are made up!” Instead, GOD is the One who placed a curse upon them, as a consequence of their disbelief. This causes them to stay in disbelief, excepting a few of them.

When a scripture came to them from GOD, confirming what they have, and even though they used to prophesy its advent to the disbelievers, when their own prophecy came to pass, they rejected it. GOD s condemnation thus afflicts the disbelievers.

Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for— disbelieving in GOD’s revelations, out of sheer resentment that GOD should bestow His grace upon whomever He chooses from among His servants. Consequently, they incurred wrath upon wrath. Such disbelievers have deserved humiliating retribution.

When they are told, “You shall believe in what GOD has sent down herein,” they say, “We believe only in what was sent down to us.” They reject subsequent revelation, even if it is the truth from their Lord, and even though it confirms what they have. Say, “(If you did believe in the revelations given to you,) why then did you kill GOD’s prophets, if you are truthful?”
Moses went to you with profound miracles, yet you worshiped the calf in his absence, and you turned wicked.

Also, we made a covenant with you, as we raised Mount Sinai above you, saying, “You shall uphold the commandments we have given you, strongly, and listen.” But they said, “We hear, but we disobey.” Their hearts became filled with adoration for the calf, due to their disbelief. Say, “Miserable indeed is what your faith dictates upon you, if you do have any faith.”
Say, “If the abode of the Hereafter is really reserved for you at GOD, to the exclusion of all other people, then you should long for death, if you are truthful.”
They never long for it, because of what their hands have sent forth. GOD is fully aware of the wicked.

In fact, you will find them the most covetous of life; even more so than the idol worshipers. The one of them wishes to live a thousand years. But this will not spare them any retribution, no matter how long they live. GOD is seer of everything they do.

Say, “Whoever is an enemy of Gabriel (should know) that he has revealed this into your heart, in accordance with GOD’s will, confirming previous scriptures, and providing guidance and good news for the believers.”
If one opposes GOD, His angels, His messengers, Gabriel, and Michael, then GOD opposes the disbelievers.
We have sent down to you clear revelations, and only the wicked will reject them.
Is it not a fact that whenever they make a covenant, some of them will violate it? Indeed, most of them do not believe.
When a messenger from GOD went to them, confirming what they have, some followers of the scripture disregarded GOD’s scripture behind their backs, as if they never had any scripture.

They pursued what the devils told them concerning the powers of Solomon. Solomon, however, was not a disbeliever, while the devils are disbelievers. Thus, they taught the people witchcraft that was sent down through the two angels of Babel, Haroot and Maroot. These two did not divulge such knowledge without pointing out that: “This is a test. You shall not abuse such knowledge.” But the people used it in such evil schemes as the breaking up of marriages. They can never harm anyone against the will of GOD. They learn only what hurts them, not what benefits them. And they knew full well that whoever practices such evil will have no share in the Hereafter. Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for, if they only knew.
Had they believed and led a righteous life, the reward from GOD would have been far better, if they only knew.
O you who believe, do not say, “Raa'ena”* (be our shepherd)-, you should say, “Unzurna” (watch over us), and listen. The disbelievers have incurred a painful retribution.

Ayet: “Our Lord, and raise among them a messenger to recite to them Your revelations, and to teach them the scripture and wisdom, and to purify them. You are the Almighty, Most Wise.”
Dipnot: *2:127-132 When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abraham Receives All Rites and Duties of Islam*
Ayet: Who would forsake the religion of Abraham, except one who cheats his own soul? We have chosen him in this world, and in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.
Dipnot: *2:127-132 When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abraham Receives All Rites and Duties of Islam*
Ayet: When his Lord said to him, “Submit,” he said, “I submit to the Lord of the universe.”
Dipnot: *2:127-132 When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abraham Receives All Rites and Duties of Islam*
Ayet: Moreover, Abraham exhorted his children to submit, and so did Jacob: “O my children, GOD has pointed out the religion for you; do not die except as Muslims.”
Dipnot: *2:127-132 When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abraham Receives All Rites and Duties of Islam*
Ayet: Had you witnessed Jacob on his death bed: he said to his children, “What will you worship after me?” they said, “We worship your god and the god of your fathers Abraham, Ismail, and Isaac; the one god. To Him we are Muslims.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Abraham Receives All Rites and Duties of Islam*
Ayet: Such is a community from the past. For them is what they earned, for you is what you earned, and you are not answerable for anything they did.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abraham Receives All Rites and Duties of Islam*
Ayet: They said, “You have to be Jewish or Christian, in order to be guided.” Say, “Instead, we follow the religion of Abraham— monotheism—he never was an idol worshiper.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers
Ayet: Say, “We believe in GOD, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed to Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs; and in what was given to Moses and Jesus, and all the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction among any of them. To Him alone we are Muslims (submitters).”

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers
Ayet: If they believe in what you believe in, then they are guided. But if they reject it, then they are in opposition. GOD will suffice you against them; He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers
Ayet: Such is GOD’s system, and whose system is better than GOD’s? “Him alone we worship.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers
Ayet: Say, “Why do you argue with us about GOD, when He is our Lord and your Lord; we are responsible for our deeds, and you are responsible for your deeds. To Him alone we are devoted.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers
Ayet: Are you saying that Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs were Jewish or Christian? Say, “Do you know better than GOD? Who is more evil than one who conceals the word of GOD? GOD is never unaware of anything you do.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers
Ayet: That was a community from the past. They are responsible for what they earned, and you are responsible for what you earned; you are not answerable for anything they have done.
The fools among the people would say, “Why did they change the direction of their Qiblah?”* Say, “To GOD belongs the east and the west; He directs whomever He wills in the right direction.”
Dipnot: *2:142 “Qiblah” is the direction we face during the contact prayers (Salat,). The Arabs were strongly prejudiced in favor of the Ka’aba as their ‘Qiblah.” The true believers were able to overcome their prejudices, and readily obeyed God and His messenger.

Ayet: We thus made you an impartial community, that you may serve as witnesses among the people, just as the messenger serves as a witness among you. We changed the direction of your original Qiblah only to distinguish those among you who readily follow the messenger from those who would turn back on their heels. It was a difficult test indeed, but not for those who are guided by GOD. GOD never puts your worship to waste. GOD is Compassionate towards the people, Most Merciful.

We have seen your face turn about the sky. Therefore, we now assign a Qiblah that is pleasing to you. Henceforth, you shall turn your face towards the Sacred Mosque. Wherever you may be, all of you shall turn your faces towards it. Indeed, those who received the scripture know that this is the truth from their Lord. GOD is never unaware of anything they do.

Even if you show the followers of the scripture any kind of miracle, they will not follow your Qiblah. Nor shall you follow their Qiblah. They do not even follow each others’ Qiblah. If you acquiesce to their wishes, after this knowledge has come to you, you will be a transgressor.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abuse of the Scripture: Selective Emphasis and Concealment
Ayet: Those who received the scripture recognize the truth herein, just as they recognize their own children. However, some of them conceal the truth, knowingly.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abuse of the Scripture: Selective Emphasis and Concealment
Ayet: This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubt about it.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abuse of the Scripture: Selective Emphasis and Concealment
Ayet: Each of you chooses the direction to follow; you shall race towards righteousness. Wherever you may be, GOD will summon you all. GOD is Omnipotent.
Wherever you go, you shall turn your face (during Salat) towards the Sacred Mosque.* This is the truth from your Lord. GOD is never unaware of anything you do.
Dipnot: *2:149 One of the glaring proofs of the idolatry committed by today’s “Muslims” is the establishment of Muhammad’s tomb as another “Sacred Mosque. ” The Quran consistently talks about one “Sacred Mosque. ”

Ayet: Wherever you go, you shall turn your face (during Salat) towards the Sacred Mosque; wherever you might be, you all shall turn your faces (during Salat) towards it. Now the people have no argument against you, except the transgressor: among them. Do not pay any attention to them; you shall devote your attention to Me. I will then perfect My blessings upon you, that you may be guided.
(Blessings) such as the sending of a messenger from among you, to recite our revelations to you, and to purify you, and to teach you the scripture and wisdom, and to teach you things you never knew.
You shall remember Me, that I may remember you. Be thankful to Me; do not be unappreciative.
O you who believe, seek help through steadfastness and the contact prayers (Salat). GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.
Do not say of those who are killed in the cause of GOD, “They are dead.” For they are alive and well at their Lord,* but you do not perceive.
Dipnot: *2:154 Death is simply another stage. See Footnote 3:169, and Appendix 17.

Ayet: We must test you with some fear, hunger, and loss of money, lives, and crops. Give good news to the steadfast,*
Dipnot: *2:155 The test is designed to prove that we will worship God ALONE under all circumstances (29:2).

Ayet: who say, when an affliction befalls them, “We belong to GOD, and to Him we ultimately return.”
These deserve blessings from their Lord, and mercy. They are the guided ones

The knolls of Safa and Marwah are consecrated by GOD. When observing Hajj or ‘Umrah, one may traverse the distance between them. If one volunteers more righteous works, then GOD is Appreciative, Omniscient.
Those who conceal our revelations and guidance, after proclaiming them for the people in the scripture, GOD condemns them; they are condemned by all the condemners.
As for those who repent, reform, and proclaim the scripture, I redeem them. I am the Redeemer, Most Merciful.
Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers, have incurred the condemnation of GOD, and the angels, and all the people.
Eternally they abide therein. The retribution is never commuted for them, nor do they receive any reprieve.
Your god is one god. There is no god besides Him, the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

In the creation of the heavens and the earth, the alternation of night and day, the ships that roam the ocean for the benefit of mankind, the water that GOD sends down from the sky to revive dead land and to sustain all kinds of creatures therein, the manipulation of the winds, and the clouds hanging between the sky and the earth there are signs for intelligent people.

Yet, some people set up idols that rival GOD, and love them as if they were GOD. Those who believe love GOD the most. If only the transgressors could see themselves when they face the retribution! They will then realize that all power belongs to GOD alone, and that GOD’s retribution is awesome.
Dipnot: *2:165-166 Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and the saints will disown their idolizers or the Day of Resurrection. See also 16:86, 46:6, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:21-23.

Ayet: Those who were followed will disown those who followed them.* They will see the retribution, and all ties among them will be severed.
Dipnot: *2:165-166 Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and the saints will disown their idolizers or the Day of Resurrection. See also 16:86, 46:6, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:21-23.

Ayet: Those who followed will say, “If we could only get another chance, we would then disown then as they have disowned us now.” Thus does GOD show them the consequences of their works as nothing but remorse; they will never exit Hell.
O people, eat from the earth’s products all that is lawful and good, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your ardent enemy.
He only commands you to commit vice and wickedness, and to attribute to GOD what you do not know.
When they are told, “Follow what GOD has revealed herein,” they say, “We follow only what we found our parents doing.” What if their parents lacked understanding, and were not guided?
The example of those who disbelieve is like those who parrot what they hear of sounds and calls, without understanding. Deaf, dumb, and blind; they cannot understand.
O you who believe, eat from the good things we provide for you, and be thankful to GOD, if you do worship Him alone.
Dipnot: *2:172-173 Throughout the Quran, four meats are prohibited (6:145, 16:115, & Appendix 16). Dietary prohibitions beyond these four are described as tantamount to idol worship (6:121). Prohibitions by other than God represent some other “god."

Ayet: He only enjoins you from eating dead animals, blood, the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than (their Creator) GOD. If one is forced (to eat these), without being malicious or deliberate, then he incurs no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
Dipnot: *2:172-173 Throughout the Quran, four meats are prohibited (6:145, 16:115, & Appendix 16). Dietary prohibitions beyond these four are described as tantamount to idol worship (6:121). Prohibitions by other than God represent some other “god."

Ayet: Those who conceal what GOD has sent down of the scripture, and sell it for a cheap price, eat but fire into their bellies. GOD will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.
It is they who bought the straying at the expense of guidance, and the retribution at the expense of forgiveness. Therefore, they will have to endure Hell.
This is because GOD has revealed this scripture, truthfully, and those who dispute the scripture are the most ardent opponents.

Righteousness is not turning your faces towards the east or the west. Righteous are those who believe in GOD, the Last Day, the angels, the scripture, and the prophets; and they give the money, despite loving it, to the relatives, the orphans, the needy, the traveling alien, the beggars, and to free the slaves; and they observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat); and they keep their word whenever they make a promise; and they steadfastly persevere in the face of adversity, hardship, and persecution. These are the truthful; these are the righteous.

O you who believe, equivalence is decreed for you when dealing with murder; the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. If one is pardoned by the victim’s kin, an equitable compensation shall be paid. This is an alleviation from your Lord and mercy. Anyone who transgresses beyond this incurs a painful retribution.
Dipnot: *2:178 The Quran clearly discourages capital punishment. Every kind of excuse is provided to spare lives, even the lives of those who commit murder. Often, the victim’s kin may find it better for all concerned, under certain circumstances, to spare the life of the murderer in exchange for an equitable compensation. Additionally, capital punishment is not to be applied, for example, if a woman kills a man, or vice versa.

Ayet: Equivalence is a life saving law for you, O you who possess intelligence, that you may be saved.
It is decreed herein that: when death approaches you, you shall write a will for the benefit of your parents and relatives, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.
If anyone alters a will he had heard, the sin of altering befalls those responsible for such altering. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
If one detects gross injustice or unreasonable bias on the part of a testator, and takes corrective action to restore justice to the will, he commits no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
O you who believe, fasting is decreed for you, as it was decreed for those before you, that you may be saved.
Dipnot: *2:183-187 Like all duties in Islam, fasting came to us through Abraham (22:78, Appendices 9 & 15). Prior to revelation of the Quran, however, sexual intercourse was prohibited throughout the fasting period. This rule was modified in 2:187 to allow intercourse during the nights of Ramadan.

Ayet: Specific days (are designated for fasting). If one is ill or traveling, an equal number of other days may be substituted. Those who can fast, but with great difficulty, may substitute feeding one poor person for each day of breaking the fast. If one volunteers (to feed more poor people), it is better. But fasting is the best for you, if you only knew.
Dipnot: *2:183-187 Like all duties in Islam, fasting came to us through Abraham (22:78, Appendices 9 & 15). Prior to revelation of the Quran, however, sexual intercourse was prohibited throughout the fasting period. This rule was modified in 2:187 to allow intercourse during the nights of Ramadan.

Ayet: Ramadan is the month during which the Quran was revealed, providing guidance for the people, and profound teachings, as well as the statute book. Those of you who witness this month shall fast. Those who are ill or traveling may substitute the same number of other days. GOD wishes for you convenience, not hardship, that you may fulfill your obligations, and to glorify GOD for guiding you, and to express your appreciation.
Dipnot: *2:183-187 Like all duties in Islam, fasting came to us through Abraham (22:78, Appendices 9 & 15). Prior to revelation of the Quran, however, sexual intercourse was prohibited throughout the fasting period. This rule was modified in 2:187 to allow intercourse during the nights of Ramadan.

Ayet: When My servants ask you about Me, I am always close. I answer the prayers of any of them when they pray to Me. They shall respond to Me, and believe in Me, that they may be guided.
Dipnot: *2:183-187 Like all duties in Islam, fasting came to us through Abraham (22:78, Appendices 9 & 15). Prior to revelation of the Quran, however, sexual intercourse was prohibited throughout the fasting period. This rule was modified in 2:187 to allow intercourse during the nights of Ramadan.

Ayet: Permitted for you during the nights of fasting is sexual intercourse with your wives. They are the keepers of your secrets, and you are the keepers of their secrets. GOD knew that you used to sneak around and cheat your souls; He has redeemed you and pardoned you. Now, you may have intercourse with them, seeking what GOD has decreed for you, and eat and drink until the white thread of light becomes distinguishable from the dark thread of night at dawn. Then fast until the night. Do not have sex with them if you retreat to the mosque (during the last ten days of Ramadan). These are GOD’s laws; do not transgress them. GOD thus clarifies His revelations for the people, that they may be saved.
Dipnot: *2:183-187 Like all duties in Islam, fasting came to us through Abraham (22:78, Appendices 9 & 15). Prior to revelation of the Quran, however, sexual intercourse was prohibited throughout the fasting period. This rule was modified in 2:187 to allow intercourse during the nights of Ramadan.

Ayet: You shall not take each others’ money illicitly, nor shall you bribe the officials to deprive others of some of their rights, illicitly, while you know.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Beat Around the Bush
Ayet: They ask you about the phases of the moon! Say, “They provide a timing device for the people, and determine the right times for Hajj.” It is not righteous to beat around the bush,* but righteousness is to uphold the commandments and to be straightforward. You shall observe GOD, that you may succeed.
Dipnot: *2:189 The literal idiom says: “Do not enter the homes through the back doors.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Beat Around the Bush
Ayet: You shall fight in the cause of GOD against those who attack you, but do not aggress. GOD does not love the aggressors.*
Dipnot: *2:190 The basic rule regulating all fighting is stated in 60:8-9.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Beat Around the Bush
Ayet: You may kill those who wage war against you, and you may evict them whence they evicted you, for oppression is worse than murder. Do not fight them at the Sacred Mosque, unless they attack you therein. If they attack you, you may kill them. This is the just retribution for such disbelievers.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Beat Around the Bush
Ayet: If they refrain, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Beat Around the Bush
Ayet: You can also fight them to counter oppression, and to worship GOD freely. If they refrain, do not aggress, except against the aggressors.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Beat Around the Bush
Ayet: Even during the Sacred Months, any aggression shall be met by an equivalent response. Thus, if they attack you, you may counter attack to inflict an equitable punishment Observe GOD, and know that GOD is with the righteous.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Beat Around the Bush
Ayet: You shall spend in the cause of GOD; do not throw yourselves with your own hands into destruction. You shall be charitable; GOD loves the charitable.

You shall observe the Hajj and ‘Umrah pilgrimage for GOD. If you are prevented, you shall send an offering, (and observe the rituals wherever you are). Do not resume cutting your hair (the last ritual) until your offering has reached its destination. If you are ill, or suffering a head injury (that forces you to cut your hair), you shall expiate by fasting, or giving a charity, or some other form of worship. During the normal observance of Hajj, if you break the state of Ihraam between ‘Umrah and Hajj, you shall expiate by offering an animal sacrifice. If you cannot afford it, you shall fast three days during Hajj and seven when you return to your homes—thus completing ten—provided you do not live at the Sacred Mosque. You shall observe GOD, and know that GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.
Dipnot: *2:196 While Hajj and ‘Umrah must be observed together during the Sacred Months, ‘Umrah may be observed any time. See the details of Hajj and ‘Umrah in Appendix 15.

Ayet: Hajj pilgrimage shall be observed during specific months.* Whoever sets out to observe Hajj therein shall abstain from sexual intercourse, misbehavior, and arguments throughout Hajj. Whatever good you do, GOD is fully aware thereof. As you prepare your provisions for the journey, remember that the best provision is righteousness. You shall observe Me, O you who possess intelligence.
Dipnot: *2:197 Hajj can be observed any time during the Sacred Months: Zul Hijjah, Muhar- ram, Safar, and Rabi I. Local governments restrict Hajj to a few days for their own convenience. See 9:37.

Ayet: You commit no error by seeking provisions from your Lord (through commerce). When you file from Arafaat, you shall commemorate GOD at the Sacred Shrine. You shall commemorate Him for guiding you; before this, you had gone astray.
You shall file together, with the rest of the people who file, and ask GOD for forgiveness. GOD Forgiver, Most Merciful.

Once you complete your rituals, you shall continue to remember GOD as you remember your own parents, or even better. Some people may say, “Our Lord, give us of this world,” while having no share in the Hereafter.
Others would say, “Our Lord, grant us in this world righteousness, and in the Hereafter righteousness, and spare us the agony of Hell.”
Each of these groups will receive the share they have earned for themselves. GOD is most efficient in reckoning.

You shall commemorate GOD for a number of days (in Mina); whoever hastens to do this in two days commits no sin, and whoever stays longer commits no sin, so long as righteousness is maintained. You shall observe GOD, and know that before Him you will be gathered.
Among the people, one may impress you with his pious utterances in this world, as he calls upon GOD to witness his innermost thoughts, while he is a most ardent opponent.
As soon as he leaves, he roams the earth corruptingly, destroying properties and lives. GOD does not love corruption.
When he is told, “Observe GOD,” he becomes arrogantly indignant. Therefore, his only destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode.
Then there is the one who dedicates his life to serve GOD; GOD is compassionate towards the worshipers.
O you who believe, enter into total submission, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your most ardent enemy.
If you backslide, despite these clear revelations, then know that GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
Are they waiting until GOD comes to them in dense clouds, together with the angels? The whole matter will then be terminated, and to GOD everything will be returned.*
Dipnot: *2:210 If God and His angels show up, everyone will believe, and the test will no longer be valid. This world is a test; it is our last chance to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan’s challenge and upholding God’s absolute authority (see the INTRODUCTION).

Ayet: Ask the Children of Israel how many profound miracles have we shown them! For those who disregard GOD’s blessings that have been manifested to them, GOD is most strict in retribution.
Dipnot: *2:211 The Quran’s mathematical miracle is a great blessing, and, therefore, brings with it an awesome responsibility (please see 5:115).

Ayet: Adorned for the disbelievers is this worldly life, and they mock those who believed. However, the righteous will be far above them on the Day of Resurrection. GOD endows whomever He wills, without limits.

The people used to be one community, until GOD sent the prophets, as bearers of good news, as well as warners, and He revealed through them the scripture, truthfully, to judge among the people in their disputes. But those who received the scripture rejected any new scripture, despite clear proofs, due to jealousy on their part. GOD guides those who believe to the truth that is disputed by others, as He wills. GOD guides whomever He wills in a straight path.*
Dipnot: *2:213 All worshipers of God ALONE (Muslims, Christians, and Jews) are truly united since the object of worship is one and the same.

Ayet: Do you expect to enter Paradise without being tested like those before you? They were afflicted with hardship and adversity, and were shaken up until the messenger and those who believed with him said, “Where is GOD’s victory?” GOD’s victory is always near.
They ask you about charity; say, “Whatever charity you give shall go to the parents, the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien.” Any good you do, GOD is fully aware thereof.

Fighting may be forced upon you, though you do not like it. But you may dislike something which is actually good for you, and you may like something which is actually bad for you. GOD knows while you do not know.

They ask you about fighting during the Sacred Months: say, “Fighting therein is a sacrilege. But repelling from the path of GOD, disbelieving in Him and in the sanctity of the Sacred Mosque, and evicting its people therefrom are greater sacrileges in the sight of GOD. For oppression is worse than murder.” They will continue to fight you in order to revert you from your religion, if they can. Those among you who revert from their religion, and die as disbelievers, have wasted all their works in this life and in the Hereafter. These will be dwellers of Hell, wherein they abide forever.
Those who believe, and those who immigrate and strive in the cause of GOD, have deserved GOD’s mercy. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

They ask you about intoxicants and gambling:* say, “In them there is gross sin, and some benefits for the people. But their sin far outweighs their benefit.” And they ask you what to spend in charity: say, “The excess.” GOD thus clarifies the revelations for you, that you may reflect—
Dipnot: *2:219 The Arabic root word for "intoxicants” is “Khamara,” which means "to veil” or "cover.” Thus, any material that veils the mind is prohibited. The world now recognizes that the economic benefits reaped by the liquor industry and illicit drug dealers are not worth the traffic fatalities, devastating injuries, birth defects, brain damage to babies, family breakdowns, and other disastrous consequences of alcohol and drugs. Alcoholic beverages in the U.S. carry warnings from the Surgeon General. Check with Alcoholics Anonymous and Gamblers Anonymous for more information. See 5:90-91.

Ayet: on this life and the Hereafter. And they ask you about the orphans: say, “Righteous upbringing is the best you can do for them. If you mix their property with yours, then treat them as members of your family.” GOD knows the righteous from the wicked. Had GOD willed, He could have imposed harsher rules upon you. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

Do not marry idolatress women unless they believe; a believing woman is better than an idolatress, even if you like her. And do not give your daughters in marriage to idolaters, unless they believe. A believer is better than the idolater, even if you like him. Those people invite to Hell, while GOD invites to Paradise and forgiveness by His leave. He clarifies His revelations for the people, that they may remember.

They ask you about menstruation: say, “It is harmful. Therefore, avoid sexual intercourse with the women during menstruation, and do not approach them until they are over it. Once they are over it, you may have intercourse with them in the manner designed by by GOD. GOD loves the repenters, and He loves those who are clean.”

Your women are the bearers of your seed. Thus, you may enjoy them however you wish, so long as you maintain righteousness. You shall observe GOD, and know that you will ultimately meet Him. Give good news to the believers.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Take God’s Name in Vain
Ayet: Do not subject GOD’s name to your casual swearing, seeking a facade of righteousness and virtue, or put on a pious appearance among the people. GOD is Hearer, Knower.

Pasaj Başlığı: Do Not Take God’s Name in Vain
Ayet: GOD does not hold you responsible for the mere utterance of oaths; He holds you responsible for your actual intentions. GOD is Forgiver, Clement.
Those who intend to estrange their wives shall wait four months (for cooling off); if they reconcile, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
If they go through with the divorce, then GOD is Hearer, Knower.

The divorced women shall wait three menstruations (before marrying another man). It is not lawful for them to conceal what GOD has created in their wombs, il they believe in GOD and the Last Day. (In case of pregnancy,) the husband’s wishes shall supersede the wife’s wishes if he wants to remarry her. The women have rights, as well as obligations, equitably. Thus, the men’s wishes prevail (in case of pregnancy). GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

Divorce may be retracted twice. The divorced woman shall be allowed to live in the same home amicably, or leave it amicably.* It is not lawful to take back anything you had given her, unless the couple fears that they may transgress GOD’s law. If there is fear that they may transgress GOD’s law, they commit no sin if the wife willingly gives anything back. These are GOD’s laws; do not transgress them. Those who transgress GOD’s laws are the unjust.
Dipnot: *2:229 It is unlawful to throw a divorced wife into the street. Housing and alimony are among the divorcee’s rights (2:241).

Ayet: If he divorces her for the third time, it is not lawful for him to remarry her, unless she marries another man, and he divorces her. The first husband can then remarry her, so long as they observe GOD’s laws. These are GOD’s laws; He explains them for people who know.

If you divorce the women, once they fulfill their interim (three menstruations), you shall allow them to live in the same home amicably, or let them leave amicably. Do not force them to stay, as a revenge. Anyone who does this wrongs his own soul. Do not take GOD’s revelations lightly, and remember GOD’s blessings upon you, and what He sent down to you of scripture and wisdom to teach you. You shall observe GOD, and know that GOD is fully aware of all things.

If you divorce the women, once they fulfill their interim, do not prevent them from remarrying their husbands, if they reconcile amicably. This will be heeded by those among you who believe in GOD and the Last Day. This is purer for you, and more righteous. GOD knows, while you do not know.

Divorced mothers shall nurse their infants two full years, if the father so wishes. The father shall provide the mother’s food and clothing, equitably. No one shall be burdened beyond capacity. No mother shall be harmed on account of her infant, nor shall the father be harmed on account of his infant. If the father dies, his inheritor shall assume these responsibilities. If the parents mutually agree to part, after due consultation, they commit no sin by doing so. You commit no sin by hiring nursing mothers, so long as you pay them equitably. You shall observe GOD, and know that GOD is Seer of everything you do.

Those who die and leave wives, their widows shall wait four months and ten days (before remarriage). Once they fulfill their interim, you commit no sin by letting them do whatever they wish, equitably. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

You commit no sin if you declare your engagement to the women, or keep it secret. GOD knows that you will think about them. But do not meet them secretly, unless you have something righteous to discuss. Do not consummate the marriage until the interim is fulfilled. You should know that GOD knows your innermost thoughts, so observe Him, and know that GOD is Forgiver, Clement.

You commit no error if you divorce the women before touching them, or before setting the dowry for them. In that case, you shall compensate them—the rich as he can afford and the poor as he can afford—an equitable compensation. This is a duty upon the righteous.

If you divorce them before touching them, but after you had set the dowry for them, the compensation shall be half the dowry, unless they voluntarily forfeit their right, or the responsible party chooses to forfeit the whole dowry. To forfeit is closer to righteousness. Do not abandon the amicable relations among you. GOD is Seer of everything you do. You Shall Observe the Daily Contact Prayers (Salat) *
You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), especially the middle prayer (the Afternoon Prayer), and devote your worship totally to GOD alone.
Dipnot: *2:238 All five prayers are found in 2:238, 11:114, 17:78, & 24:58. When the Quran was revealed, Salat had already been in existence (Appendices 9 & 15).

Ayet: Under unusual circumstances, you may pray while walking or riding. Once it is safe, you shall commemorate GOD as He taught you what you never knew.

For those who die and leave wives, a will shall provide their wives with support for one year, provided they stay within the same household. If they leave, you commit no sin by letting them do whatever they wish, so long as righteousness is observed. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
The divorcees also shall be provided for, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.
GOD thus explains His revelations for you, that you may understand.

Pasaj Başlığı: Striving in the Cause of God
Ayet: Have you noted those who fled their homes, though they were in the thousands, fearing death? GOD said to them, “Die,” then revived them. GOD showers His blessings upon the people, but most people are not appreciative.

Pasaj Başlığı: Striving in the Cause of God
Ayet: You shall fight in the cause of GOD, and know that GOD is Hearer, Knower.

Pasaj Başlığı: Striving in the Cause of God
Ayet: Would you not lend GOD a good loan, to have it repaid to you multiplied manifold? GOD is the One who provides and withholds, and to Him you will be returned.

Have you noted the leaders among the Children of Israel after Moses? They said to their prophet, “If you appoint a king to lead us, we will fight in the cause of GOD.” He said, “Is it your intention that, if fighting is imposed upon you, you will not fight?” They said, “Why should we not fight in the cause of GOD, when we were evicted from our homes, together with our children?” Yet, when fighting was decreed for them, they turned away, except a few. GOD is fully aware of the transgressors.
Dipnot: *2:246 This same history is narrated in the Bible’s Book of I Samuel, Ch. 9 and 10.

Ayet: Their prophet said to them, “GOD has appointed Taloot (Saul) to be your king.” They said, “How can he be our king when we are more worthy of kingship than he is? He is not even rich!” He said, “GOD has chosen him over you, and has blessed him with an abundance in knowledge and in body.” GOD grants His kingship to whomever He wills. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.

Their prophet said to them, “The sign of his kingship is that the Ark of the Covenant will be restored to you, bringing assurance from your Lord, and relics left by the people of Moses and Aaron. It will be carried to you by the angels. This should be a convincing sign for you, if you are really believers.”

When Saul took command of the troops, he said, “GOD is putting you to the test by means of a stream. Anyone who drinks from it, does not belong with me, unless it is to taste a single sip.” They drank from it, except a few. When he crossed it, together with those who believed, they said, “Now we lack the strength to face Goliath and his troops.” Those who believed in meeting GOD said, “Many a small army defeated a large army by GOD’s leave. GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.”
When they faced Goliath and his troops, they prayed, “Our Lord, grant us steadfastness, strengthen our foothold, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Believers Always Victorious
Victory Comes Only From God
Ayet: They defeated them by GOD’s leave, and David killed Goliath. And GOD granted him kingship and wisdom, and taught him as He willed. If it were not for GOD’s support of some people against others, there would be chaos on earth. GOD s grace encompasses all creation.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Believers Always Victorious
Victory Comes Only From God
Ayet: These are GOD’s revelations. We recite them through you, truthfully, for you are one of the messengers.*
Dipnot: *2:252 For the exact, mathematically proven identity of this messenger, see Appendices 2 and 26.

Ayet: We have blessed some messengers more than others. For example, GOD spoke to one of them. And we raised some of them to higher ranks. And we gave Jesus the son of Mary profound miracles, and supported him with the Holy Spirit. Had GOD willed, their followers would not have fought with each other, despite the clear proofs that came to them. Instead, they disputed among themselves; some of them believed, and some disbelieved. Had GOD willed, they would not have fought. But GOD does whatever He wills.
O you who believe, give from our provisions to you, before a day comes where there is no trade, no nepotism, and no intercession. The disbelievers are the unjust.
Dipnot: *2:254 One of Satan’s cleverest tricks is attributing the power of intercession to powerless human idols such as Jesus and Muhammad (Appendix 8).

Ayet: GOD: there is no other god besides Him, the Living, the Eternal. Never a moment of unawareness or slumber overtakes Him. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on the earth. Who could intercede with Him, except in accordance with His will? He knows their past, and their future. No one attains any knowledge, except as He wills. His dominion encompasses the heavens and the earth, and ruling them never burdens Him. He is the Most High, the Great.

There shall be no compulsion in religion: the right way is now distinguished from the wrong way. Thus, anyone who denounces the devil and believes in GOD, has gotten hold of the strongest bond that never breaks. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

GOD the Lord of those who believe; He leads them out of darkness into the light. As for those who disbelieve, their lords are the devils; they lead them out of the light into darkness. They have deserved Hell, wherein they abide forever.

Have you noted the one who argued with Abraham about his Lord, though GOD had given him kingship? Abraham said, “My Lord grants life and death.” He said, “I grant life and death.” Abraham said, “GOD brings the sun from the east, can you bring it from the west?” The disbeliever was stumped. GOD does not guide the wicked.

Or the one who passed by a ghost town and wondered, “How can GOD revive this, after it had died?” GOD then put him to death for one hundred years, then resurrected him. He said, “How long have you been here?” He said, “I have been here one day, or part of the day.” He said, “You have been here a hundred years. Yet, look at your food and drink; they did not spoil. And look at your donkey—we thus render you a lesson* for the people. Note how we construct the bones, then cover them with flesh.” When he realized what had happened, he said, “Now I know that GOD is Omnipotent.”
Dipnot: *2:259 The lesson we learn is that the time between death and resurrection passes like one night (see also 18:19-25 and Appendix 17).

Ayet: Abraham said, “My Lord, show me how You revive the dead.” He said, “Do you not believe?” He said, “Yes indeed, but I wish to reassure my heart.” He said, “Take four birds, study their marks, place a piece of each bird on top of a hill, then call them to you; they will come to you in a hurry. And know that GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.”

The example of those who spend their money in the cause of GOD is that of a grain that produces seven spikes, with a hundred grains in each spike. And GOD multiplies this manifold for whomever He wills. GOD is Bounteous, Knower.

Those who give their money in the cause of GOD, then do not follow their charity with insult or reproach, will receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
Kind words and compassion are better than a charity that is followed by insult. GOD is Rich, Clement.

O you who believe, do not nullify your charities by inflicting insult and harm. As for those who spend their money to show off, while disbelieving in GOD and the Last Day, their example is like a rock that is covered with a thin layer of soil; when heavy rain falls, the soil washes off, leaving the rock barren and useless. Thus, they gain nothing from their efforts. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.

The example of those who give their money seeking GOD’s pleasure, and in response to their own convictions, is that of a high fertile soil; when heavy rain falls, it produces twice the yield. If heavy rain is not available, a drizzle will suffice. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

Does any of you wish to own a garden of palm trees and grapes, with flowing streams, and generous crops, then, just as he grows older, with children who are still dependent on him, a holocaust strikes and burns up his garden? GOD thus clarifies the revelations for you, that you may reflect.

O you who believe, you shall give to charity from the good things you earn, and from the products we provide for you from the earth. Do not pick out that which is bad to give away, when you yourselves would not accept it unless your eyes were closed. You should know that GOD is Rich, Praiseworthy.
The devil promises you poverty, and commands you to commit evil, while GOD promises you forgiveness from Him, and grace. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.
He bestows wisdom upon whomever He chooses, and whoever attains wisdom, has attained a great bounty. Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
Any charity you give, or a charitable pledge you fulfill, GOD is fully aware thereof. As for the wicked, they have no supporters.

If you declare your charities, they are still good. But if you keep them anonymous, and give them to the poor, it is better for you, and remits more of your sins. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

Pasaj Başlığı: God is the Only One Who Guides
Ayet: You are not responsible for guiding them. GOD is the only one who guides; He guides whomever He wills. Any charity you give is for your own good. Any charity you give shall be only for the sake of GOD. Any charity you give will be repaid to you, without the least injustice.

Pasaj Başlığı: God is the Only One Who Guides
Ayet: Charity shall go to the poor who are suffering in the cause of GOD, and cannot emigrate. The unaware may think that they are rich, due to their dignified appearance. You can recognize them by their marks; they never engage in begging from the people. Whatever charity you give, GOD is fully aware thereof.

Pasaj Başlığı: God is the Only One Who Guides
Ayet: Those who give to charity night and day, secretly and publicly, receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

Those who take usury are in the same position as those who are possessed by the devil. This is because they claim that usury is the same as trade. GOD has made trade lawful, and has made usury unlawful. Whoever heeds this commandment from his Lord, and refrains from usury, he may keep his past earnings, and his judgment rests with GOD. As for those who persist, they incur Hell; they abide therein forever.
Dipnot: *2:275-278 If interest on loans or deposits is excessive, it constitutes usury. Many people do not possess the ability, energy, or know-how to invest their money. They do not commit any error by depositing their money with financial institutions, and earning interest. The institutions invest their money on their behalf. Financial institutions oi individuals charging in excess of 15-20% interest Per Annum are committing usury.

Ayet: GOD condemns usury, and blesses charities. GOD does not love any disbeliever, guilty.
Dipnot: *2:275-278 If interest on loans or deposits is excessive, it constitutes usury. Many people do not possess the ability, energy, or know-how to invest their money. They do not commit any error by depositing their money with financial institutions, and earning interest. The institutions invest their money on their behalf. Financial institutions oi individuals charging in excess of 15-20% interest Per Annum are committing usury.

Ayet: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life, and observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), will receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
Dipnot: *2:275-278 If interest on loans or deposits is excessive, it constitutes usury. Many people do not possess the ability, energy, or know-how to invest their money. They do not commit any error by depositing their money with financial institutions, and earning interest. The institutions invest their money on their behalf. Financial institutions oi individuals charging in excess of 15-20% interest Per Annum are committing usury.

Ayet: O you who believe, observe GOD and refrain from all kinds of usury, if you are really believers.
Dipnot: *2:275-278 If interest on loans or deposits is excessive, it constitutes usury. Many people do not possess the ability, energy, or know-how to invest their money. They do not commit any error by depositing their money with financial institutions, and earning interest. The institutions invest their money on their behalf. Financial institutions oi individuals charging in excess of 15-20% interest Per Annum are committing usury.

Ayet: If you do not, then expect war from GOD and His messenger. But if you repent, you may keep your capitals, without inflicting injustice, or incurring injustice.
If the debtor is unable to pay, you shall wait for a better time. If you forfeit the loan as a charity, it would be better for you, if you only knew.
Beware of the day when you are returned to GOD, then each soul is paid for everything it had earned, without the least injustice.

O you who believe, if you transact a loan for any period, you shall write it down. Let an impartial scribe do the writing for you. No scribe shall refuse to perform this service, in accordance with GOD’s teachings. He shall write, while the debtor dictates the terms. He shall observe GOD his Lord, and never cheat. If the debtor is mentally incapable, or helpless, or cannot dictate, his guardian shall dictate equitably. You shall have two witnesses from among your men. If two men are not available, then choose one man and two women* whose testimony is acceptable to all parties. Thus, if one woman becomes biased the other will remind her. The witnesses shall not refuse to testify whenever needed. Do not tire of writing all the details, no matter how long, and write down the time of repayment. This is more equitable at GOD, assures better witnessing, and eliminates any doubts you may have in the future. As for trade transactions that you execute on the spot, you need not record them, but have them witnessed. No scribe or witness shall be harmed on account of his services. If you harm them, it will be wickedness on your part. You shall observe GOD, then GOD will teach you. GOD is Omniscient.
Dipnot: *2:282 Monetary transactions are the only events where two women substitute for one man. If the witnesses were one man and one woman, the possibility arises that they may marry each other. In this case, the welfare of one party in the transaction may be jeopardized. Oppressive men tend to generalize this verse.

Ayet: If you are traveling, and no scribe is available, a bond shall be posted to guarantee repayment. If one is trusted in this manner, he shall return the bond when due. He shall observe GOD his Lord. Do not withhold any testimony by concealing what you had witnessed. Anyone who withholds a testimony has a sinful heart. GOD is fully aware of everything you do.

To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. Whether you declare your innermost thoughts, or keep them hidden, GOD holds you responsible for them. He then forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Do Not Make Any Distinction
Among God's Messengers
Ayet: The messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. They believe in GOD, His angels, His scripture, and His messengers: “We make no distinction among any of His messengers,” and they proclaim: “We hear, and we obey. Forgive us, our Lord. To You is the ultimate destiny.”

Pasaj Başlığı:
Do Not Make Any Distinction
Among God's Messengers
Ayet: GOD never burdens any soul beyond its means: to its credit is whatever it earns, and against it is whatever it commits. “Our Lord, do not condemn us if we forget or make mistakes. Our Lord, and protect us from blaspheming against You, like those before us have done. Our Lord, protect us from burdens that are heavy beyond our capacity, pardon us, and forgive us. You are our Lord and Master, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”
A.L.M.*
Dipnot: *3:1 See Footnote 2:1 and Appendix One.

Ayet: GOD: there is no god except He; the Living, the Eternal.
He sent down to you this scripture, truthfully, confirming all previous scriptures, and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel—
before that, to guide the people. He sent down the statute book. Those who disbelieve in GOD’s revelations incur severe retribution. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.
Nothing is hidden from GOD, in the earth, or in the heaven.
He shapes you in the wombs as He wills. There is no god except He; the Almighty, the Most Wise.

He revealed to you this scripture, consisting of straightforward verses, which are the essence of the scripture, as well as multiplemeaning verses. Those who harbor doubt in their hearts will pursue the multiple-meaning verses to create confusion, and to seek different meanings. No one knows their true meaning except GOD and those who possess knowledge. They say, “We believe in this, for it all comes from our Lord.” Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
Our Lord, let not our hearts waver after You have guided us, and shower us with Your mercy; You are the Grantor.
Our Lord, You will surely summon all the people on a day that is inevitable. GOD never breaks a promise.
Those who disbelieve cannot be helped by their money or children against GOD. They are the fuel of Hell.
Like Pharaoh’s people and others before them who rejected our revelations; GOD punished them for their sins. GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.
Say to those who disbelieve, “You will be defeated, then gathered in Hell; what a miserable abode!”

An example has been set for you by the two armies who clashed. One army was fighting in the cause of GOD, while the other was disbelieving. They saw them as twice as many with their own eyes. GOD supports with His victory whomever He wills. This should be a lesson for those who possess vision.

Adorned for the people are such pleasures as women, children, piles upon piles of gold and silver, trained horses, livestock, and crops. Such are the vanities of this world. GOD possesses a far better abode.

Say, “Let me inform you of something that is far better than that: for those who lead a righteous life, at their Lord, gardens with flowing streams, and pure spouses. They rejoice in GOD’s approval.” GOD is Seer of His worshipers.
They say, “Our Lord, we have believed; forgive us our sins, and spare us the agony of the hellfire.”
They are steadfast, truthful, submitting, charitable, meditators at dawn.
GOD bears witness that there is no god except He,* and so do the angels and those who possess knowledge. He is the absolute god. There is no god except He,* the Almighty, the Wise.
Dipnot: *3:18 The First Pillar of Islam is “Shahaadah,” professing that there is no other god besides God. The words of “Shahaadah” are decreed in this verse by God Himself: “La Elaaha Ella Allah.” Any other “Shahaadah,” proclaiming that Muhammad is God’s messenger is, by definition, idol-worship. It also violates the major commandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, & 4:150-152 prohibiting any distinction among God’s messengers.

Ayet: The only religion approved by GOD is Islam. Those who received the scripture dispute this fact, knowingly. This is due to jealousy on their part. For those who reject GOD’s revelations, GOD is most strict in reckoning.

If they argue with you, then say, “I have submitted myself to GOD; me and those who follow me.” And say to those who received the scripture, as well as those who did not receive any scripture, “Do you accept Islam as your religion?” If they do accept Islam, then they are guided. If they turn away, then your sole mission is to deliver the message. GOD is Seer of all the people.
Those who reject GOD’s revelations and kill the prophets unjustly, and kill those who advocate justice among the people, promise them painful retribution.
It is these who nullify their works in this worldly life and in the Hereafter. They will have no helpers.

Pasaj Başlığı: They Do Not Believe in the Eternity of Hell
Ayet: Have you noted those who were given part of the scripture, and were invited to uphold this scripture of GOD? Some of them have turned away in aversion.

Pasaj Başlığı: They Do Not Believe in the Eternity of Hell
Ayet: This is because they said, “The hellfire will not afflict us, except for a few days.” They were thus deceived in their religion, by their own fabrications.

Pasaj Başlığı: They Do Not Believe in the Eternity of Hell
Ayet: How will it be for them when we summon them on that inevitable day? Each soul will then be paid for everything it had earned, and no one will be wronged.

Pasaj Başlığı: They Do Not Believe in the Eternity of Hell
Ayet: Say, “Our god: King of all kingship. You grant kingship to whomever You will, and remove kingship from whomever You will. You bestow dignity upon whomever You will, and humiliate whomever You will. In Your hand is all bounty. You are Omnipotent.

Pasaj Başlığı: They Do Not Believe in the Eternity of Hell
Ayet: “You merge the night into the day, and merge the day into the night. You produce the living from the dead, and the dead from the living. You provide for whomever You choose, without limits.”

The believers do riot ally themselves with disbelievers instead of believers. Whoever does this does not belong with GOD, unless you are forced to do this under the scourge of severe persecution. GOD alerts you that you should beware of Him alone. To GOD is the ultimate destiny.
Say, “Whether you conceal your innermost thoughts, or declare them, GOD is fully aware thereof.” He is fully aware of everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omnipotent.

The day will come when each soul will find everything good it had done brought forth. As for the evil works, it will wish that they were farther removed than the east is from the west. GOD alerts you that you should beware of Him alone. GOD is Compassionate towards the worshipers.
Proclaim (O Quran): “If you love GOD, you should follow me.” GOD will then love you, and forgive your sins. GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.
Proclaim: “Obey GOD and the messenger.” If they turn away, then GOD dislikes the disbelievers.
GOD has chosen (as messengers) Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the Amramites from among the people.
They are all related to each other. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
The wife of Amram said, “My Lord, I have dedicated (the baby) in my belly to You, completely, so accept from me. You are Hearer, Omniscient.”

When she gave birth to her, she said, “My Lord, I have given birth to a girl”—GOD was fully aware of what she bore—“The male is not the same as the female. I have named her Mary, and I invoke Your protection for her and her descendants, from Satan the rejected.”

Her Lord accepted her a gracious acceptance, and brought her up a gracious upbringing, under the guardianship of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah entered her sanctuary, he found provisions with her. He would ask, “Mary, where did you get this from?” She would say, “It is from GOD. GOD provides for whomever He chooses, without limits.”
That is when Zachariah implored his Lord: “My Lord, grant me such a good child; You are the Hearer of prayers.”
The angels called him while he was praying in the sanctuary: GOD gives you good news of John; a believer in the word of GOD, honorable, moral, and a righteous prophet.”
He said, “Will I have a son despite my old age, and my wife’s sterility?” He said, “GOD does whatever He wills.”

He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you do not speak to the people for three days, except by signals. You shall commemorate your Lord frequently, and meditate night and day.”
The angels said, “O Mary, GOD has chosen you; He has purified you, and has chosen you over all the women.
“O Mary, submit to your Lord, fall prostrate, and bow down with those who bow down.”
This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You were not present when they drew their raffles to select Mary’s guardian. You were not present when they feuded among themselves.

The angels said, “O Mary, GOD gives you good news of a Word from Him whose name shall be ‘The Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary. He will be prominent in this world and in the Hereafter, and one of those closest to Me.’
“He will speak to the people from the crib, and as an adult. He will be among the righteous.”
She said, “My Lord, how can I have a son, when no man has touched me?” He said, GOD thus creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He simply says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.
“He will teach him the scripture, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel.

“As a messenger to the Children of Israel, he will proclaim: ‘I come to you with proof from your Lord; I create for you the shape of a bird, from clay, then I blow into it, and it becomes a live bird, by GOD’s leave. I restore vision to the blind, I heal the leprous, and I revive the dead by GOD’s leave. I can tell you what you ate, and what you store in your homes. These should be sufficient proofs, if you are believers.
‘I am here to confirm the previous scripture, the Torah, and to revoke certain prohibitions imposed upon you. I come to you with proof from your Lord. Therefore, you shall observe GOD, and obey me.
‘GOD is my Lord and your Lord;* you shall worship Him alone. This is a straight path.’ ”
Dipnot: *3:51 This is precisely what Jesus is quoted to say throughout the New Testament. See for example the Gospel of John 20:17, and the book “Doctrine Development in Christianity” by Lisa Spray, Ch. 3 (Renaissance Productions, Tucson, Arizona 1989).

Ayet: When Jesus sensed disbelief on their part, he said, “Who are my supporters towards GOD?” The disciples said, “We are GOD’s supporters; we believe in GOD, and bear witness that we are Muslims.
“Our Lord, we believe in what You have revealed, and we follow the messenger, so write us among the witnesses.”
They schemed, but so did GOD, and GOD is the best schemer.
Dipnot: *3:54-55 We learn that Jesus’ soul, the real person, was raised; i.e., Jesus’ life on earth was terminated, and his enemies crucified his body, an empty shell (See Appendix 22).

Ayet: Thus, GOD said, “O Jesus, I am terminating your life on earth, raising you to Me, and ridding you of the disbelievers. I will raise those who follow you, above those who disbelieve, from now until the Day of Resurrection. To Me is your ultimate return, then I will judge among you regarding everything you disputed.
Dipnot: *3:54-55 We learn that Jesus’ soul, the real person, was raised; i.e., Jesus’ life on earth was terminated, and his enemies crucified his body, an empty shell (See Appendix 22).

Ayet: “As for those who disbelieve, I will commit them to painful retribution in this world, and in the Hereafter. They will have no helpers.”
As for those who believe, and lead a righteous life, He will pay them fully. GOD dislikes the unjust.
We recite for you in these revelations, a message that is full of wisdom.
The example of Jesus, as far as GOD is concerned, is the same as that of Adam; He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was.
Dipnot: *3:59 The similarity between the creation of Jesus and Adam is confirmed mathematically; both men are mentioned in the Quran the same number of times (25 times each).

Ayet: This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubt about it.

If anyone argues with you, after this knowledge has come to you, then say, “Let us summon our children and your children, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then let us invoke GOD’s curse upon the liars.”
This narration is the absolute truth. Absolutely, there is no other god besides GOD. Absolutely, GOD is the Almighty, the Most Wise.
If they dispute these facts, then GOD is fully aware of the evildoers.

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: Say, “O followers of the scripture, let us come to a logical agreement between us and you: that we do not worship except GOD, that we never set up any idols besides Him, and never set up each other as gods beside GOD.” If they reject such an agreement, then say, “Bear witness that we are Muslims.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: O followers of the scripture, why do you argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Do you not understand?

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: You have argued about things you knew, but why do you argue about things you do not know? GOD knows, while you do not know.

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: Abraham was neither Jewish, nor Christian; he was a monotheist Muslim. He never was an idol worshiper.

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: The people most worthy of Abraham are those who followed him, and this prophet, and those who believe. GOD is the Lord and Master of the believers.

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: Some followers of the scripture wish to lead you astray, but they only lead themselves astray, without perceiving.

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: O followers of the scripture, why do you reject these revelations of GOD, while you bear witness?

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: O followers of the scripture, why do you confound the truth with falsehood, and conceal the truth, knowingly?

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: Some followers of the scripture said, “Believe in what was sent down to the believers in the morning, and reject it in the evening. This may discourage them, and may cause them to revert.

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: “You must believe only those who follow your religion.” Say, “The right guidance is GOD’s guidance.” If they claim that they have equally good guidance, or argue with you about your Lord, then say, “All the blessings are in GOD s hand; He bestows them upon whomever He wills.” GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.

Pasaj Başlığı: Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement
Ayet: He showers His mercy upon whomever He wills; GOD possesses unlimited grace.

Some followers of the scripture can be trusted with a whole lot, and they will repay you. And some of them, if you trust them with a single Dinar, they will not repay it unless you keep after them. That is because they say, “We do not have to be honest when dealing with the gentiles!”* Thus, they attribute lies to GOD, knowingly.
Dipnot: *3:75 Prior to the discovery of the Quran’s mathematical code, some scholars falsely claimed that Muhammad was an illiterate man who could not write such a great book They distorted the meaning of the word ((Ummy,” claiming that it meant “illiterate.’ This verse proves that “Ummiyyeen” means “gentiles” (Appendix 28).

Ayet: Indeed, if one fulfills his obligations, and leads a righteous life, then GOD loves the righteous.

As for those who trade away GOD’s covenant and their obligations for a cheap price, they get no share in the Hereafter. GOD will not speak to them, nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

Some of them twist their tongues to imitate the scripture, that you may think it is from the scripture, when it is not from the scripture. They then claim that it is from GOD, when it is not from GOD. They utter lies and attribute them to GOD, knowingly.

Never would a human being whom GOD has blessed with the scripture and prophethood say to the people, “Be worshipers of me besides GOD.” Instead, (he would say), “Be devoted to your Lord alone, in accordance with the scripture you received, and learned.”
Nor would he command you to set up the angels and the prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelieve after becoming Muslims?

Pasaj Başlığı:
Major Prophecy Fulfilled*
God’s Messenger of the Covenant
Ayet: GOD took a covenant from the prophets, saying, “After I have given you the scripture and wisdom, a messenger will come to confirm what you have. You shall believe in him and support him.” He said, “Do you agree with this, and pledge to uphold this covenant?” They said, “We agree.” He said, “You have thus borne witness, and I am with you a witness."
