Ayet: A narration about your Lord’s mercy towards His servant Zachariah.
He called his Lord, a secret call.
He said, “My Lord, the bones have turned brittle in my body, and my hair is aflame with gray. As I implore You, my Lord, I never despair.
“And I fear for my (female) dependants after me, for my wife has been sterile. Grant me, from You, an heir.
“Let him be my heir and the heir of Jacob’s clan, and make him, my Lord, acceptable.”
“O Zachariah, we give you good news; a boy whose name shall be John (Yahya). We never created anyone like him before.”
He said, “My Lord, will I have a son despite my wife’s sterility, and despite my old age?”
He said, “Thus said your Lord: ‘It is easy for Me to do. I created you before that, and you were nothing.’ ”
He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three consecutive nights.”
He came out to his family, from the sanctuary, and signaled to them: “Meditate (on God) day and night.”
“O John, uphold the scripture, strongly.” We endowed him with wisdom, even in his youth.
And (we endowed him with) kindness from us, and purity; he was righteous.
He was kind to his parents, never a disobedient tyrant.
Peace be upon him the day he was born, the day he dies, and the day he is resurrected back to life.
Mention in the scripture Mary. She isolated herself from her family, into an eastern location.
While a barrier separated her from them, we sent to her our Spirit. He went to her in the form of a perfect man.
She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Gracious, unless you are righteous.”
He said, “I am the messenger of your Lord, to grant you a pure child.”
She said, “How can I have a child, when no man has touched me, and I have never been unchaste.”
He said, “Thus said your Lord, ‘It is easy for Me. We will render him a sign for the people, and mercy from us. This matter is already decided.’ ”
When she bore him, she isolated herself to a faraway place.
The birth pangs came to her by the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “(I am so ashamed;) I wish I were dead, and completely forgotten.”
(The infant) called her from beneath her, saying, “Do not grieve. Your Lord has provided you with a stream.
“And if you shake the trunk of this palm tree, it will drop ripe dates for you.*
Dipnot: *19:25 Thus, Jesus was born in late September or early October. This is when dates ripen in the Middle East to the point of falling off the tree.

Ayet: “Eat and drink, and be happy. When you see anyone, say, ‘I have made a vow of silence; I am not talking, today, to anyone.’ ”
She came with him to her family, carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something gross.
“O descendant of Aaron, your father was not a bad man, nor was your mother unchaste.”
She pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk with an infant in the crib?”
(The infant spoke and) said, “I am a servant of GOD. He has given me the scripture, and made me a prophet.
“He made me blessed wherever I go, and enjoined me to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat) for as long as I live.
“I am to honor my mother; He did not make me a disobedient rebel.
“And peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I get resurrected.”
Such was Jesus, the son of Mary. This is the truth of this matter, about which they have a lot of doubt.
GOD is never to beget a son, be He glorified. To have anything done, He simply says to it, “Be,” and it is.
He also proclaimed, “GOD is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him alone. This is the straight path.”*
Dipnot: *19:36 This is similar to the statement attributed to Jesus in the Gospel of John 20:17.

Ayet: The various parties disputed among themselves (regarding the identity of Jesus). Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve from the sight of a terrible day.
Wait till you hear them and see them when they come to face us. The transgressors on that day will be totally astray.
Warn them about the day of sorrow, when judgment will be issued. For they are totally oblivious; they do not believe.
We are the ones who inherit the earth and everyone on it; to us they will be returned.
Mention in the scripture Abraham; he was a saint, a prophet.
He said to his father, “O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor help you in any way?
“O my father, I have received certain knowledge that you did not receive. Follow me, and I will guide you in a straight path.
“O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil has rebelled against the Most Gracious.
“O my father, I fear lest you incur retribution from the Most Gracious, then become a slave of the devil.”
He said, “Are you rejecting my gods, O Abraham? Unless you stop, I will surely stone you. Leave me alone.”
He said, “Peace be upon you. I will implore my Lord to forgive you; He has been Most Kind to me.
“I will abandon you and the gods you worship besides GOD. I will worship only my Lord. By imploring only my Lord alone, I cannot go wrong.”
Because he abandoned them and the gods they worshiped besides GOD, we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we made each of them a prophet.
We showered them with our mercy, and we granted them an honorable position in history.
Mention in the scripture Moses. He was devoted, and he was a messenger prophet.
We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai. We brought him close, and we conferred with him.
And we granted him, out of our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet.
And mention in the scripture Ismail. He was truthful when he made a promise, and he was a messenger prophet.
He used to enjoin his family to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat); he was acceptable to his Lord.
And mention in the scripture Idris. He was a saint, a prophet.
We exalted him to an honorable rank

These are some of the prophets whom GOD blessed. They were chosen from among the descendants of Adam, and the descendants of those whom we carried with Noah, and the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom we guided and selected. When the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they fall prostrate, weeping.
After them, He substituted generations that lost the contact prayers (Salat), and pursued their lusts. Consequently, they will go astray.
Only those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life will enter Paradise, without the least injustice.
(They enter) the gardens of Eden, which the Most Gracious has promised for His worshipers in the future. Certainly, His promise will come to pass.
They will not hear any nonsense therein; only peace. They receive their provisions therein, endlessly.
Such is Paradise; we grant it to those among our creatures who are righteous.
We do not come down except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs our past, our future, and everything between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.
The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; you shall worship Him and steadfastly persevere in worshiping Him. Do you know of anyone who equals Him?
The human being asks, “After I die, do I come back to life?”
Does the human not remember that we created him, and he was nothing?
By your Lord, we will certainly summon them, together with the devils. We will gather them around Hell, humiliated.
Then we will pick out from each group the most ardent opponent of the Most Gracious.
For we know full well those who are most deserving of burning therein.
Every single one of you must experience Hell; this is an irrevocable decision of your Lord.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: They said, “Our Lord, we fear lest he may attack us, or transgress.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “Do not be afraid. I will be with you, listening and watching.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: “Go to him and say, ‘We are two messengers from your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go, and do not persecute them. We bring a sign from your Lord. Peace be upon those who follow the guidance.’ ”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: (They said to Pharaoh) “We have been inspired that the retribution will inevitably afflict those who disbelieve and turn away.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “Who is the Lord of the two of you, O Moses.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “Our Lord is the One who granted everything its existence, and its guidance.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “What about the past generations?”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you. He paved for you roads therein. And He sends down from the sky water whereby we produce many different kinds of plants.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: Eat and herd your livestock. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.
Dipnot: *20:54 Those who possess intelligence appreciate the fact that we are astronauts who were launched into space on this ‘Spaceship Earth.’ God provided us with renewable food, water, pets, wildlife, and livestock, as we embark on this temporary space odyssey. Compare God’s ‘Spaceship Earth’ with our spaceships and astronauts (Appendix 7).

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: From it we created you, into it we return you, and from it we bring you out once more.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: We showed him all our signs, but he disbelieved and refused.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “Did you come here to take us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: “We will surely show you similar magic. Therefore, set an appointment that neither we, nor you will violate; in a neutral place.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “Your appointed time shall be the day of festivities. Let us all meet in the forenoon.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: (On the appointed day,) Pharaoh summoned his forces, and came.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: Moses said to them, “Woe to you. Do you fabricate lies to fight GOD and thus incur His retribution? Such fabricators will surely fail.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: They disputed among themselves, as they conferred privately.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: They said, “These two are no more than magicians who wish to take you out of your land with their magic, and thus destroy your ideal way of life.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: “Let us unite our plans and face them as a united front. The winner today will surely succeed.” *

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: They said, “O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: He said, “You throw.” Whereupon, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their trickery, as if they were moving.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: Moses harbored some fear.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: We said, “Have no fear. You will prevail.

Pasaj Başlığı: The End of the World Not Hidden*
Ayet: “Throw what you hold in your right hand, and it will swallow whatever they fabricated. What they fabricated is no more than the scheming of a magician. The magician’s work will not succeed.”
The magicians fell prostrate, saying, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”

He said, “Did you believe in him without my permission? He must be your chief; the one who taught you magic. I will surely cut your hands and feet on alternate sides. I will crucify you on the palm trunks. You will find out soon which of us can inflict the worst retribution, and who outlasts whom.”
They said, “We will not prefer you over the clear signs that came to us, and over the One who created us. Therefore, issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life.
“We have believed in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic that you had forced us to perform. GOD is far better and Everlasting.”
Anyone who comes to his Lord guilty, will incur Hell, wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.
As for those who come to Him as believers who had led a righteous life, they attain the high ranks.
The gardens of Eden, beneath which rivers flow. They abide therein forever. Such is the reward for those who purify themselves.
We inspired Moses: “Lead My servants out, and strike for them a dry road across the sea. Do not fear getting caught; do not worry.”
Pharaoh pursued them with his troops. The sea overwhelmed them, as it was destined to overwhelm them.
Thus, Pharaoh misled his people; he did not guide them.
O Children of Israel, we delivered you from your enemy, summoned you to the right side of Mount Sinai, and we sent down to you manna and quails.
Eat from the good things we provided for you, and do not transgress thereby, lest you incur My wrath. Whoever incurs My wrath has fallen.
I am surely Forgiving for those who repent, believe, lead a righteous life, and steadfastly remain guided.
“Why did you rush away from your people, O Moses?”
He said, “They are close behind me, and I rushed to You my Lord, that You may be pleased.”
He said, “We put your people to the test after you left, and the Samarian misled them.”

Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, saying, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Could you not wait? Did you want to incur wrath from your Lord? Is this why you broke your covenant with me?”
They said, “We did not break our covenant with you on purpose. But we were loaded down with jewelry, and decided to throw our loads in. This is what the Samarian suggested.”
He produced for them a calf, complete with a calf’s sound.* They said, “This is your god, and the god of Moses.” Thus, he forgot.
Dipnot: *20:88 & 96 The Samarian went to the spot where God spoke to Moses, and grabbed a fistful of dust upon which God’s voice had echoed. This dust, when mixed with the molten gold caused the golden statue to acquire the sound of a calf.

Ayet: Do they not see that it neither responded to them, nor possessed any power to harm them, or benefit them?
And Aaron had told them, “O my people, this is a test for you. Your only Lord is the Most Gracious, so follow me, and obey my commands.”
They said, “We will continue to worship it, until Moses comes back.”
He said, “O Aaron, what stopped you when you saw them go astray—
“from following my orders? Have you rebelled against me?”
He said, “O son of my mother; do not pull me by my beard and my head. I was afraid that you might say that I divided the Children of Israel, and did not follow your orders.”
He said, “What is the matter with you, O Samarian?”

He said, “I saw what they could not see, so I grabbed a fistful (of dust) from the place where the messenger stood, and used it (to mix into the golden calf). This is what my mind inspired me to do.”*

He said, “Then go, and, throughout your life, do not even come close. You have an appointed time (for your final judgment) that you can never evade. Watch your god that you used to worship; we will burn it and throw it into the sea, to stay there forever.”
Your only god is GOD; the One besides whom there is no other god. His knowledge encompasses all things.
We thus narrate to you some news from the past generations. We have given you a message from us.
Those who disregard it will bear a load (of sins) on the Day of Resurrection.
Eternally they abide therein. What a miserable load on the Day of Resurrection!
That is the day when the horn is blown, and we summon the guilty on that day blue.
Whispering among themselves, they will say, “You have stayed (in the first life) no more than ten!”
We are fully aware of their utterances. The most accurate among them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”
They ask you about the mountains. Say, “My Lord will wipe them out.
“He will leave them like a barren, flat land.
“Not even the slightest hill will you see therein, nor a dip.”
On that day, everyone will follow the caller, without the slightest deviation. All sounds will be hushed before the Most Gracious; you will hear nothing but whispers.
On that day, intercession will be useless, except for those permitted by the Most Gracious, and those whose utterances conform to His will.
He knows their past and their future, while none encompasses His knowledge.
All faces will submit to the Living, the Eternal, and those who are burdened by their transgressions will fail.
As for those who worked righteousness, while believing, they will have no fear of injustice or adversity.
We thus revealed it, an Arabic Quran, and we cited in it all kinds of prophecies that they may be saved, or it may cause them to take heed.
Most Exalted is GOD, the only true King. Do not rush into uttering the Quran before it is revealed to you, and say, “My Lord, increase my knowledge.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: We tested Adam in the past, but he forgot, and we found him indecisive.
Dipnot: *20:115 When Satan challenged God’s absolute authority (38:69), you and I did not make a firm stand against Satan. God is giving us a chance, on this earth, to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan and upholding God’s absolute authority (Appendix 7).

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: And when we said to the angels, “Fall prostrate before Adam,” they fell prostrate, except Satan; he refused.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: We then said, “O Adam, this is an enemy of you and your wife. Do not let him evict you from Paradise, lest you become miserable.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: “You are guaranteed never to hunger therein, nor go unsheltered.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: “Nor will you thirst therein, nor suffer from any heat.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: But the devil whispered to him, saying, “O Adam, shall I show you the tree of eternity and unending kingship?”

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: They ate from it, whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Adam disobeyed his Lord, and went astray.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: Then his Lord chose him, redeemed him, and guided him.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: He said, “Go down therefrom, all of you, as enemies of one another. When guidance comes to you from Me, anyone who follows My guidance will not go astray, nor suffer any misery.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: “As for the one who disregards My message, he will have a miserable life, and we will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection blind.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: He will say, “My Lord, why did you summon me blind, when I used to be a seer?”

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: He will say, “Because you forgot our revelations when they came to you, you are now forgotten.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: We thus requite those who transgress and refuse to believe in the revelations of their Lord. The retribution in the Hereafter is far worse and everlasting.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: Does it ever occur to them how many previous generations we have annihilated? They are now walking in the homes of those before them. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: If it were not for your Lord’s predetermined plan, they would have been judged immediately.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And during the night glorify Him, as well as at both ends of the day, that you may be happy.

Pasaj Başlığı: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
Ayet: And do not covet what we bestowed upon any other people. Such are temporary ornaments of this life, whereby we put them to the test. What your Lord provides for you is far better, and everlasting.

You shall enjoin your family to observe the contact prayers (Salat), and steadfastly persevere in doing so. We do not ask you for any provisions; we are the ones who provide for you. The ultimate triumph belongs to the righteous.
They said, “If he could only show us a miracle from his Lord!” Did they not receive sufficient miracles with the previous messages?
Had we annihilated them before this, they would have said, “Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have followed Your revelations, and would have avoided this shame and humiliation.”
Say, “All of us are waiting, so wait; you will surely find out who are on the correct path, and who are truly guided.”
Fast approaching is the reckoning for the people, but they are unaware, averse.
Whenever a reminder comes to them from their Lord, which is new, they listen to it heedlessly.
Their hearts are heedless. And the transgressors confer secretly: “Is he not just a human being like you? Would you accept magic when you see it?”*
Dipnot: *21:3 Although both the Bible (Malachi 3:3) and the Quran (3:81) clearly prophesy the advent of God’s Messenger of the Covenant, when he did appear, supported with ‘one of the greatest miracles’ (74:30-35), he was met with heedlessness and opposition. The divine assertion that every ‘new’ revelation is opposed has been proven by the fierce opposition to the Quran’s great miracle, (see Appendices 1 & 2).

Ayet: He said, “My Lord knows every thought in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.”
They even said, “Hallucinations,” “He made it up,” and, “He is a poet. Let him show us a miracle like the those of previous messengers.”
None of the communities that we annihilated in the past were believers. Are these people believers?
We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask the experts if you do not know.
We did not give them bodies that did not eat, nor were they immortal.
We fulfilled our promise to them; we saved them with whomever we willed, and annihilated the transgressors.
We have sent down to you a scripture containing your message. Would you not understand?
Many a community we terminated because of their transgression, and we substituted other people in their place.
When our requital came to pass, they started to run.
Do not run, and come back to your luxuries and your homes, for you must be held accountable.
They said, “Woe to us. We were really wicked.”
This continued to be their proclamation, until we completely wiped them out.
We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them just to play.
If we needed entertainment, we could have initiated it without any of this, if that is what we wanted to do.
Instead, it is our plan to support the truth against falsehood, in order to defeat it. Woe to you for the utterances you utter.
To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth, and those at Him are never too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they ever waver.
They glorify night and day without tiring.
Have they found gods on earth who can create?
If there were in them (the heavens and the earth) other gods besides GOD, there would have been chaos. Glory be to GOD; the Lord with absolute authority. He is high above their claims.
He is never questioned about anything He does, while all others are questioned.

Have they found other gods besides Him? Say, “Show me your proof. This message to my generation is the same message given to the generations before me.” Indeed, most of them do not recognize the truth; this is why they are averse.
We did not send any messenger before you except with the inspiration: “There is no god except Me; you shall worship Me alone.”
Still, they said, “The Most Gracious has begotten a son!” Glory be to Him. All (messengers) are (His) honored servants.
They never initiate any utterances; they strictly follow His commands.
He knows their future and their past. They do not intercede, except for those already accepted by Him, and they are worried about their own necks.*
Dipnot: *21:28 The myth of intercession is Satan’s most effective bait (see Appendix 8).

Ayet: If any of them claims to be a god besides Him, we requite him with Hell; we thus reward the wicked.
Do the unbelievers not realize that the heaven and the earth used to be one solid mass that we exploded into existence? And from water we made all living things. Would they believe?
Dipnot: *21:30 The Big Bang Theory is now supported by the Creator’s infallible mathematical code (Appendix 1). Thus, it is no longer a theory; it is a proven fact.

Ayet: And we placed on earth stabilizers, lest it tumbles with them, and we placed straight roads therein, that they may be guided.
And we rendered the sky a guarded ceiling. Yet, they are totally heedless of the signs therein.
And He is the One who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in its own orbit.
We never decreed immortality for anyone before you; should you die, are they immortal?
Every soul will taste death, after we put you to the test through adversity, as well as prosperity, then to us you ultimately return.
When those who disbelieved see you, they ridicule you: “Is this the one who talks about your idols?” They totally disregard the message of the Most Gracious.
The human being is impatient by nature. I will surely show you My signs; do not be in such a hurry.
They challenge: “Where is that (retribution), if you are truthful?”
If only those who disbelieved could realize how it will be when they try to ward the fire off their faces and their backs! They will receive no help.
Indeed, it will come to them so suddenly, they will be utterly stunned. They can neither repel it, nor receive any respite.
Messengers before you have been ridiculed, and those who ridiculed them have incurred the consequence: of their ridiculing.
Say, “Who takes care of you during the night and the day, other than the Most Gracious?” Indeed, they are totally disregarding the message of their Lord.
Do they have gods who can protect them from us? They cannot even help themselves. Nor can they accompany one another when they face us.
We have provided for these people and their ancestors, up until an old age. Do they not see that every day on earth brings them closer to the end? Can they reverse this process?
Say, “I am warning you in accordance with divine inspiration.” However, the deaf cannot hear the call, when they are warned.
When a sample of your Lord’s retribution afflicts them, they readily say, “We were indeed wicked.”

We will establish the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection. No soul will suffer any injustice. Even the equivalent of a mustard seed will be accounted for. We are the most efficient reckoners.
We gave Moses and Aaron the Statute Book, and a beacon, and a reminder for the righteous—
who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and they worry about the Hour.
This too is a blessed reminder that we have sent down. Are you denying it?
Before that, we granted Abraham his understanding, for we were fully aware of him.*
Dipnot: *21:51 Was Abraham so smart as to discover God, or, did God grant him the intelligence because He knew that he deserved to be saved? As it turns out, this whole world was created to redeem those among us who deserve redemption. When the angels suggested to throw us all in Hell, God told them, ‘I know what you do not know’ (2:30). At the same time, this world proves Satan’s incompetence as a god (App. 7).

Ayet: He said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are devoting yourselves?”
They said, “We found our parents worshiping them.”
He said, “Indeed, you and your parents have gone completely astray.’
They said, “Are you telling us the truth, or are you playing?”
He said, “Your only Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who created them. This is my testimony.
“I swear by GOD, I have a plan to deal with your statues, as soon as you leave.”
He broke them into pieces, except for the big one, that they may refer to it.
They said, “Whoever did this to our gods is really a transgressor.”
They said, “We heard a youth threaten them; his name is Abraham.”
They said, “Bring him before the eyes of all the people; let them bear witness.”
They said, “Did you do this to our gods, O Abraham?”
He said, “It is that big one who did it. Go ask them, if they can speak.”
They were taken aback, and said to themselves, “Indeed, you have been wrong.”
Yet, they reverted to their old ideas: “You know full well that these cannot speak.”
He said, “Do you then worship besides GOD what possesses no power to benefit you or harm you?
“Shame on you and on whatever you worship besides GOD. Do you not understand?”
They said, “Burn him and support your gods, if this is what you decide to do.”
We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”
Thus, they schemed against him, but we made them the losers.
We saved him, and we saved Lot, to the land that we blessed for all the people.
And we granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift, and we made them both righteous.

Pasaj Başlığı: Abraham: Delivered All Religious Duties of Islam
Ayet: We made them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, and we taught them how to work righteousness, and how to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat).* To us, they were devoted worshipers.
Dipnot: *21:73 When the Quran was revealed, all religious duties were already established through Abraham (2:128, 16:123, 22:78).

Ayet: And we granted Lot wisdom and knowledge, and we saved him from the community that practiced abominations; they were wicked and evil people.
We admitted him into our mercy, for he was righteous.
And, before that, Noah called and we responded to him. We saved him and his family from the great disaster.
We supported him against the people who rejected our revelations. They were evil people, so we drowned them all.
And David and Solomon once ruled with regard to someone’s crop that was destroyed by another’s sheep. We witnessed their judgment.

We granted Solomon the correct understanding, though we endowed both of them with wisdom and knowledge. We committed the mountains to glorify (God) and to serve David, as well as the birds. This is what we did.
And we taught him the skill of making shields to protect you in war. Are you then thankful?
For Solomon, we committed the wind gusting and blowing in his service. He could direct it as he wished, to whatever land he chose, and we blessed such land for him. We are fully aware of all things.
And of the devils there were those who would dive for him (to harvest the sea), or do whatever else he commanded them to do. We kept them in his service.
And Job implored his Lord: “Adversity has befallen me, and, of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful.”
We responded to him, relieved his adversity, and restored his family for him, and doubled them. That was a mercy from us, and a reminder for the worshipers.
Also, Ismail, Idris, Zal-Kifl; all were steadfast, patient.
We admitted them into our mercy, for they were righteous.

And Zan-Noon (Jonah, “the one with an ‘N ’ in his name”), abandoned his mission in protest, thinking that we could not control him. He ended up imploring from the darkness (of the big fish’s belly): “There is no other god besides You. Be You glorified. I have committed an error.’
We responded to him, and saved him from misery; we thus save the believers.
And Zachariah implored his Lord: “My Lord, do not keep me without an heir, though You are the best inheritor.”

We* responded to him and granted him John; we fixed his wife for him. That is because they always hastened to work righteousness, and implored us in situations of joy, as well as fear. To us, they were reverent.
Dipnot: *21:90 The use of the plural tense throughout Quran indicates participation of the angels. For example, it is clear from 3:39 and from the Bible that the angels dealt with Zachariah extensively, as they gave him the good news about John. See Appendix 10.

Ayet: And (recall) the one who maintained her virginity, then we blew into her from our spirit. We rendered her and her son a sign for the whole world.
Such (are the messengers of) your congregation—one congregation—and I am your Lord; you shall worship Me alone.
Unfortunately, they divided themselves into disputing factions. All of them will come back to us (for judgment).
As for those who work righteousness, while believing, their work will not go to waste; we are recording it.
It is forbidden for any community we had annihilated to return.
Not until Gog and Magog reappear,* will they then return—they will come from every direction.
Dipnot: *21:96 By the year 2270 AD, thanks to God’s mathematical miracle in the Quran (Appendix 1), America will be the heart of Islam, and billions around the globe will have believed in the Quran (9:33, 41:53, 48:28, 61:9). Gog and Magog, will be the only bastions of heathenism, and they will attack the Muslims. That is when the world will end (15:87, 18:94, Appendix 25). God has not yet revealed the identity of Gog and Magog.

Ayet: That is when the fulfillment of the truthful promise will approach. The disbelievers will stare in horror: “Woe to us. We were oblivious to this. In fact, we have been wicked.”
You and the idols you worship besides GOD will be fuel for Hell; this is your inevitable destiny.
If these were gods, they would not have ended in Hell. They all abide therein forever.
They will sigh and groan therein, and they will have no access to anything, while they abide therein.
As for those who deserved beautiful rewards from us, they will be protected.
They will not hear its hissing. They will abide in everything they desire, forever.
The great horror will not worry them, for the angels will receive them joyfully: “This is your day, that has been promised to you.”
On that day, we will fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. Just as we initiated the first creation, we will repeat it. This is our promise; we will certainly carry it out.
We have decreed in the Psalms, as well as in other scripture, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous worshipers.
This is a proclamation for people who are worshipers.
We have sent you (O Muhammad) out of mercy from us towards the whole world.
Proclaim, “I have been given divine inspiration that your god is one god. Will you then submit?”
If they turn away, then say, “I have warned you sufficiently, and I have no idea how soon or late (the retribution) will come to you.
“He is the only One who knows your public utterances, and He knows whatever you conceal.
“I have no idea; this may be a test for you, and a temporary enjoyment.”
Say, “My Lord, You judge equitably. Our Lord is the Most Gracious; only His help is sought in the face of your claims.”
O people, reverence your Lord, for the quaking of the Hour is something horrendous.

The day you witness it, (it will be so horrendous that) a nursing mother will even discard her infant, and a pregnant woman will abort her fetus. And you will see the people staggering as if they are intoxicated, even though they are not intoxicated. But GOD’s retribution is awesome.
Among the people, there are those who argue about GOD without knowledge, and follow every rebellious devil.
It is decreed that anyone who allies himself with him, he will mislead him and guide him to the agony of Hell.

O people, if you have any doubt about resurrection, (remember that) we created you from dust, and subsequently from a tiny drop, which turns into a hanging (embryo), then it becomes a fetus that is given life or deemed lifeless. We thus clarify things for you. We settle in the wombs whatever we will for a predetermined period.* We then bring you out as infants, then you reach maturity. While some of you die young, others live to the worst age, only to find out that no more knowledge can be attained beyond a certain limit. Also, you look at a land that is dead, then we shower it with water, and it vibrates with life and grows all kinds of beautiful plants.
Dipnot: *22:5 The Quran’s mathematical miracle is based on the number 19. As it turns out, this number represents the Creator’s signature on His creations. Thus, you and I have 209 bones in our bodies (209=19x11). The length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days (19x14) (Langman’s Medical Embryology, T. W. Sadler, Page 88, 1985). The Jewish Calendar must be adjusted once every 19years, because the sun, the moon, and the earth line up in the same relative position once every 19 years.

Ayet: This proves that GOD is the Truth, and that He revives the dead, and that He is Omnipotent.
And that the Hour is coming, no doubt about it, and that GOD resurrects those who are in the graves.
Among the people there is the one who argues about GOD without knowledge, and without guidance, and without an enlightening scripture.
Arrogantly he strives to divert people from the path of GOD. He thus incurs humiliation in this life, and we commit him on the Day of Resurrection to the agony of burning
This is what your hands have sent ahead for you. GOD is never unjust towards the people.

Among the people there is the one who worships GOD conditionally. If things go his way, he is content. But if some adversity befalls him, he makes an about-face. Thus, he loses both this life and the Hereafter. Such is the real loss.
He idolizes besides GOD what possesses no power to harm him or benefit him; this is the real loss.
He idolizes what is more apt to harm him than benefit him. What a miserable lord; what a miserable companion.
GOD admits those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. GOD does whatever He wills.

If anyone thinks that GOD cannot support him in this life and in the Hereafter, let him turn completely to (his creator in) heaven, and sever (his dependence on anyone else). He will then see that this plan eliminates anything that bothers him.
We thus revealed clear revelations, then GOD guides whomever He wills.

Those who believe, those who are Jewish, the converts, the Christians, the Zoroastrians, and the idol worshipers, GOD is the One who will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection. GOD witnesses all things.

Do you not realize that to GOD prostrates everyone in the heavens and the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and the animals, and many people? Many others are committed to doom. Whomever GOD shames, none will honor him. GOD does whatever He wills.
Here are two feuding parties with regard to their Lord. As for those who disbelieved, they will have clothes of fire tailored for them. Hellish liquid will be poured on top of their heads.
Dipnot: *22:19-22 People who have insisted on going to Hell will inevitably complain: ‘Had we known how bad this is, we would have behaved differently. ’ They will be told that the horrors of Hell have been pointed out to them in the most graphic, though symbolic, terms. It should be noted that Heaven and Hell are almost invariably mentioned together in the Quran.

Ayet: It will cause their insides to melt, as well as their skins.
Dipnot: *22:19-22 People who have insisted on going to Hell will inevitably complain: ‘Had we known how bad this is, we would have behaved differently. ’ They will be told that the horrors of Hell have been pointed out to them in the most graphic, though symbolic, terms. It should be noted that Heaven and Hell are almost invariably mentioned together in the Quran.

Ayet: They will be confined in iron pots.
Dipnot: *22:19-22 People who have insisted on going to Hell will inevitably complain: ‘Had we known how bad this is, we would have behaved differently. ’ They will be told that the horrors of Hell have been pointed out to them in the most graphic, though symbolic, terms. It should be noted that Heaven and Hell are almost invariably mentioned together in the Quran.

Ayet: Whenever they try to exit such misery, they will be forced back in: “Taste the agony of burning.”
Dipnot: *22:19-22 People who have insisted on going to Hell will inevitably complain: ‘Had we known how bad this is, we would have behaved differently. ’ They will be told that the horrors of Hell have been pointed out to them in the most graphic, though symbolic, terms. It should be noted that Heaven and Hell are almost invariably mentioned together in the Quran.

Ayet: GOD will admit those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
They have been guided to the good words; they have been guided in the path of the Most Praised.

Surely, those who disbelieve and repulse from the path of GOD, and from the Sacred Mosque that we designated for all the people—be they natives, or merely visiting it—and seek to corrupt it, we will afflict them with painful retribution.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam,
Decreed Through Abraham*
Ayet: We appointed Abraham to establish the Shrine: “You shall not idolize any other god besides Me, and purify My shrine for those who visit it, those who live near it, and those who bow and prostrate.
Dipnot: *22:26-27 Abraham was the original messenger of Islam. See 22:78 and Appendix 9.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam,
Decreed Through Abraham*
Ayet: “And proclaim that the people shall observe Hajj pilgrimage.* They will come to you walking or riding on various exhausted (means of transportation). They will come from the farthest locations.”
Dipnot: *22:26-27 Abraham was the original messenger of Islam. See 22:78 and Appendix 9.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam,
Decreed Through Abraham*
Ayet: They may seek commercial benefits, and they shall commemorate GOD’s name during the specified days for providing them with livestock. “Eat therefrom and feed the despondent and the poor.”

Pasaj Başlığı:
Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam,
Decreed Through Abraham*
Ayet: They shall complete their obligations, fulfill their vows, and visit the ancient shrine.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam,
Decreed Through Abraham*
Ayet: This is a duty; and those who uphold the commandments decreed by GOD, have deserved a good reward at their Lord. All livestock is made lawful for your food, except for those specifically prohibited for you. You shall avoid the abomination of idol worship, and avoid bearing any false witness.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam,
Decreed Through Abraham*
Ayet: You shall maintain your devotion absolutely to GOD alone. Anyone who sets up any idols besides GOD is like one who fell from the sky, and was snatched up by the vultures, or blown away by the wind into a deep ravine.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam,
Decreed Through Abraham*
Ayet: Indeed, those who reverence GOD s commandments, demonstrate the righteousness of their hearts.
The (livestock) provide you with many benefits for a period, before being donated to the ancient shrine.

For each congregation we have decreed a ritual whereby they commemorate the name of GOD for providing them with the livestock. Your god is one and the same god; you shall all submit to Him. Give good news to the obedient.
They are the ones whose hearts tremble upon mentioning GOD, they steadfastly persevere during adversity, they observe the contact prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them, they give.

The animal offerings were included in GOD s rituals for your own good.* You shall mention GOD’s name on them while they are standing in line. You shall eat therefrom and feed the poor and the needy. This is why we have subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation.
Dipnot: *22:36 Animal offerings from the pilgrims conserve the resources at the pilgrimage site. Note that almost 2,000,000 pilgrims converge on Mecca during pilgrimage.

Ayet: Neither their meat, nor their blood reaches GOD. What reaches Him is your righteousness. He has subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation by glorifying GOD for guiding you. Give good new to the good doers.
GOD defends those who believe. GOD does not love any betrayer, unappreciative.
Injustice has befallen those who are being persecuted, and GOD is certainly able to support them.

They were evicted from their homes unjustly, for no reason except their saying, “Our Lord is GOD.” If it were not for GOD’s supporting of some people against others, monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques, where the name of GOD is commemorated frequently, would have been destroyed. Most assuredly, GOD supports those who support Him. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.

If we appoint them as rulers on earth they are the ones who establish the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat), and advocate righteousness and forbid evil. GOD is the ultimate ruler.
If they disbelieve you, the people of Noah, ‘Aad, and Thamoud have also disbelieved before them.
And the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot.
And the dwellers of Midyan. And Moses was disbelieved. I led all those people on, then I called them to account; how (devastating) was My requital!
Many a community have we annihilated because of their wickedness. They ended up with ruins, stilled wells, and empty mansions.

Have they not roamed the earth, then used their minds to understand, or their ears to hear? Indeed, the real blindness in not the blindness of the eyes, but the blindness of the hearts inside the chests.
They challenge you to bring retribution, and GOD never breaks His promise. A day of your Lord is like a thousand of your years.
Many a community in the past committed evil; I led them on for awhile, then I called them to account; to Me is the ultimate destiny.
Say, “O people, I have been sent to you as a profound warner.”*
Dipnot: *22:49 This command is directed specifically to God’s Messenger of the Covenant This fact, and the specific name of the messenger are mathematically coded into the Quran. See the details, together with physical evidence, in Appendices 2 and 26.

Ayet: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they deserve forgiveness and a generous recompense.
As for those who strive to challenge our revelations, they deserve Hell.

We did not send before you any messenger, nor a prophet, without having the devil interfere in his wishes. GOD then abrogates the consequences of the devil’s interference. GOD perfects His revelations. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.
He thus sets up the devil’s scheme as a test for those who harbor doubts in their hearts, and those whose hearts are hardened. Indeed, the wicked are in manifest opposition.

At the same time, this allows those who are endowed with knowledge to realize that this is the truth from your Lord. They will then believe in it, and their hearts will readily accept it. Most assuredly, GOD guides the believers in a straight path.
As for those who disbelieve, they will continue to harbor doubts, until the Hour comes to them suddenly, or the retribution of a terrible day comes to them.

Pasaj Başlığı: No More Temporary Kingship For Satan
Ayet: All kingship on that day belongs to GOD. He will judge among them. As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they will be in the gardens of bliss.

Pasaj Başlığı: No More Temporary Kingship For Satan
Ayet: As for those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations, they incur a shameful retribution.

Pasaj Başlığı: No More Temporary Kingship For Satan
Ayet: Those who emigrated for the sake of GOD, then got killed, or died, GOD will surely shower them with good provisions. GOD is certainly the best Provider.

Pasaj Başlığı: No More Temporary Kingship For Satan
Ayet: Most assuredly, He will admit them an admittance that will please them. GOD is Omniscient, Clement.
It is decreed that if one avenges an injustice, equitably, then is persecuted because of that, GOD will surely grant him victory. GOD is Pardoner, Forgiving.
This is as guaranteed as the fact that GOD merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night, and that GOD is Hearer, Seer.
This is as guaranteed as the fact that GOD is the Truth, while any idols they set up besides Him are falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, the Supreme.
Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water that turns the land green? GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything in the earth. Most assuredly, GOD is the Rich, Most Praised.

Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything on earth? The ships run in the ocean by His command. He prevents the heavenly bodies from crashing with the earth, except in accordance with His command. GOD is Most Kind towards the people, Most Merciful.
He is the One who granted you life, then puts you to death, then brings you back to life. Surely, the human being is unappreciative.
For each congregation, we have decreed a set of obligations that they must uphold. Therefore, let them not dispute with you, and invite to your Lord. Most assuredly, you are on the right path.
If they argue with you, then say, “GOD is fully aware of everything you do.”
GOD will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection regarding all your disputes.
Do you not realize that GOD knows everything in the heavens and everything on earth? All this is recorded in a record. This is easy for GOD.
Yet, they idolize besides GOD idols wherein He placed no power, and they know nothing about them. Such transgressors have no helper.

When our revelations are recited for them, you recognize wickedness on the faces of those who disbelieved. They almost attack those who recite our revelations to them. Say, “Shall I inform you of something much worse? Hell is promised by GOD for those who disbelieved; what a miserable destiny.”

O people, here is a parable that you must consider carefully: the idols you call upon besides GOD can never create a fly, even if they banded together to do so. Furthermore, if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it; weak is the pursuer and the pursued.
They do not value GOD as He should be valued. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.
GOD chooses from among the angels messengers, and from among the people. GOD is Hearer, Seer.
He knows their past and their future. To GOD belongs the ultimate control of all matters.
O you who believe, bow, prostrate, worship your Lord, and work righteousness, that you may succeed.

And strive for the cause of GOD as you should strive for His cause. He has chosen you and placed no hardship on you in practicing your religion—the religion of your father Abraham. He is the one who named you “Muslims” (Submitters), originally. Thus, the messenger shall serve as a witness among you, and you shall serve as witnesses among the people. You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and hold fast to GOD; He is your Lord, the best Lord and the best Supporter.
Dipnot: *22:78 Although all messengers preached one and the same message: “Worship God alone,” Abraham was the Grst messenger to coin the terms “Islam” and “Muslim’ (2:128). What did Abraham contribute to Islam? We learn from 16:123 that all religious duties in Islam were revealed through Abraham (see Appendices 9 & 26).

Ayet: Successful indeed are the believers.
Who are reverent during their contact prayers (Salat).
And they avoid vain talk.
And they give their obligatory charity (Zakat).
And they maintain their chastity.
Only with their spouses, or those who are rightfully theirs (as in common-law marriages), do they have sexual relations; they are not blamed.
Those who transgress these limits are the sinful ones.
When it comes to deposits entrusted to them, they are trustworthy. And they honor their agreements.
And they observe their contact prayers (Salat) regularly.
Such are the inheritors.
They will inherit Paradise, wherein they abide forever.
We created the human being from a special kind of mud.
Subsequently, we reproduced him from a tiny drop, that is placed into a well protected repository.

Then we developed the drop into a hanging (embryo), then developed the hanging (embryo) into a bite-size (fetus), then created the bite-size (fetus) into bones, then covered the bones with flesh. then produced a new creature. Most blessed is GOD, the best Creator.
Then, later on, you die.
On the Day of Resurrection, you will be resurrected.
We created above you seven universes in layers, and we are never unaware of a single creature therein.
And we sent water from the sky, in exact measure, and stored it in the ground. Certainly, we could have let it escape.
With it, we produced for you orchards of date palms, grapes, all kinds of fruits, and various foods.
A tree that grows near Mount Sinai produces oil and relish for the eaters.
And the livestock should provide you with a lesson. We let you drink (milk) from their bellies, you derive many benefits from them, and you eat some of them.
On them, and on the ships, you ride
We sent Noah to his people, saying, “O my people, worship GOD. You have no other god besides Him Would you not be righteous?”

The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, “This is no more than a human like you, who wants to gain a higher rank above you. Had GOD willed, He could have sent angels. We never heard of anything like this from our ancestors.
“He is simply a man gone crazy. Just ignore him for awhile.”
He said, “My Lord, give me victory, for they have disbelieved me.”

We then inspired him: “Make the watercraft* under our watchful eyes, and by our inspiration. When our command comes, and the pot boils over, put on it a pair of every kind (of your domesticated animals), and your family, except those condemned to be doomed. And do not speak to Me on behalf of those who transgressed; they will be drowned.
Dipnot: *23:27 The story tellers have created a mockery of Noah’s history. Noah’s ark was a flat watercraft made of logs, tied together with primitive ropes (54:13), the flood was local, around the Dead Sea area, and the animals were Noah’s domesticated animals.

Ayet: “Once you are settled, together with those who are with you, on the watercraft, you shall say, ‘Praise GOD for saving us from the evil people.’
“And say, ‘My Lord, let me disembark onto a blessed location; You are the best deliverer.’ ”
These should provide sufficient signs for you, that we must put you to the test.
We established another generation after them.
And we sent to them a messenger from among them: “You shall worship GOD. You have no other god besides Him. Would you not be righteous?”

The leaders among his people who disbelieved and rejected the idea of the Hereafter—although we provided for them generously in this life—said, “This is no more than a human being like you. He eats from what you eat, and drinks as you drink.
“If you obey a human being like you, you are really losers.
“Does he promise you that after you die and turn into dust and bones you will come back?
“Impossible, impossible indeed is what is promised to you.
“We only live this life—we live and die—and we will never be resurrected
“He is just a man who fabricates lies and attributes them to GOD. We will never believe him.”
He said, “My Lord, grant me victory, for they have disbelieved me.”
He said, “Soon they will be sorry.”
The disaster struck them, equitably, and thus, we turned them into ruins. The wicked people perished.
Then we established other generations after them.
No community can advance its predetermined fate, nor delay it.

Then we sent our messengers in succession. Every time a messenger went to his community, they disbelieved him. Consequently, we annihilated them, one after the other, and made them history. The people who disbelieved have perished.
Then we sent Moses and his brother Aaron with our revelations and a profound proof—
to Pharaoh and his elders, but they turned arrogant. They were oppressive people.
They said, “Shall we believe for two men whose people are our slaves?”
They rejected the two, and consequently, they were annihilated.
We gave Moses the scripture, that they may be guided.
And we made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and we gave them refuge on a mesa with food and drink.
O you messengers, eat from the good provisions, and work righteousness. I am fully aware of everything you do
Such is your congregation—one congregation—and I am your Lord; you shall observe Me.
But they tore themselves into disputing factions; each party happy with what they have.
Therefore, just leave them alone in their confusion, for awhile.
Do they think that since we provided them with money and children,—
we must be showering them with blessings? Indeed, they do not perceive.
Surely, those who are reverently conscious of their Lord,
And who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
And who never set up any idols besides their Lord,
And who give their charities while their minds know full well that they will be summoned before their Lord,
These are the ones who hasten to work righteousness; they are always far ahead.
We never burden any soul beyond its means, and we keep a record that presents the truth. No one will suffer injustice.
Because their minds are oblivious to this, they commit works that do not conform with this. Such are their works.
Then, when we afflict their leaders with retribution, they complain.
Do not complain; today you cannot receive any help.
My revelations were recited to you, but you turned back on your heels.
You were too arrogant to accept them; you disregarded them.
Have they not reflected on this scripture? Have they attained something never attained by their ancestors?
Have they failed to recognize their messenger? Is this why they are disregarding him?
Have they decided that he is crazy? Indeed, he has brought the truth to them, but most of them hate the truth.

Indeed, if the truth were to follow their opinions, there would be chaos in the heavens and the earth, and everything in them. We have given them their reminder, but they are disregarding their reminder.
Are you asking them for a wage? Your Lord’s wage is far better. He is the best Provider.
Most assuredly, you are inviting them to a straight path.
It is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter that deviate from the path.
Had we showered them with mercy, and relieved their adversity, they would have plunged deeper into their transgressions.
Even when we afflicted them with retribution, they never turned to their Lord; they never implored.
When we showered them with well deserved retribution, they were shocked.
He is the One who granted you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains. Rarely are you appreciative.
He is the One who established you on earth, and before Him you will be summoned.
He is the One who controls life and death, and He is the One who alternates the night and day. Do you not understand?
They said what their ancestors said.
They said, “After we die and turn into dust and bones, we get resurrected?
“Such promises were given to us and to our parents in the past. These are no more than tales from the past.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: Say, “To whom belongs the earth and everyone on it, if you know?”
Dipnot: *23:84-89 Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: They will say, “To GOD.” Say, “Why then do you not take heed?”
Dipnot: *23:84-89 Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven universes; the Lord of the great dominion?”
Dipnot: *23:84-89 Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: They will say, “GOD.” Say, “Why then do you not turn righteous?”
Dipnot: *23:84-89 Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: Say, “Who possesses kingship over all things, and He provides support but needs no support, if you know?”
Dipnot: *23:84-89 Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: They will say, “GOD.” Say, “Where did you go wrong?”
Dipnot: *23:84-89 Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: We have given them the truth herein, and they are liars.

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: GOD has never begotten a son. Nor was there ever any other god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have declared independence with his creations, and they would have competed with each other for dominance. GOD be glorified; far above their claims.

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: The Knower of all secrets and declarations; be He exalted, far above having a partner.

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: Say, “My Lord, if You show me (the retribution) they have incurred—

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: “let me not be, my Lord, with the transgressing people.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: To show you (the retribution) we have reserved for them is something we can easily do.

Pasaj Başlığı: Most Believers are Going to Hell*
Ayet: Therefore, just counter their evil with goodness; we are fully aware of their claims.
Say, “My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the devils.
“And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they come near me.”

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: When death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: “I will then work righteousness in everything I left.” Not true. This is a false claim that he makes. A barrier will separate the soul from this world until resurrection.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: When the horn is blown, no relations among them will exist on that day, nor will they care about one another.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: As for those whose weights are heavy, they will be the winners.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: Those whose weights are light are the ones who lost their souls; they abide in Hell forever.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: Fire will overwhelm their faces, and they last miserably therein.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: Were not My revelations recited to you, and you kept on rejecting them?

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: They will say, “Our Lord, our wickedness overwhelmed us, and we were people gone astray.

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: “Our Lord, take us out of this; if we return (to our old behavior), then we are really wicked.”

Pasaj Başlığı:
The Dead Never Come Back
Until the Day of Resurrection
Ayet: He will say, “Abide therein, humiliated, and do not speak to Me.
“A group of My servants used to say, ‘Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and shower us with mercy; You are the best of all the merciful ones.’
“But you mocked and ridiculed them, until they caused you to forget to commemorate Me. You used to laugh at them.
“I have rewarded them today, in return for their steadfastness, by making them the winners.”
He said, “How long did you last on earth? How many years?”
They said, “We lasted a day or part of a day. Ask those who count.”
He said, “In fact, you stayed but a short while, if you only knew.
“Did you think that we created you in vain; that you were not to be returned to us?”
Most exalted is GOD, the true King. There is no other god besides Him; the Most Honorable Lord, possessor of all authority.
Anyone who idolizes besides GOD any other god, and without any kind of proof, his reckoning rests with his Lord. The disbelievers never succeed.
Say, “My Lord, shower us with forgiveness and mercy; You are the best of all the merciful ones.”
A sura that we reveal, and decree as a law. We reveal in it clear revelations, that you may take heed.

The adulteress and the adulterer you shall whip each of them a hundred lashes. Do not be swayed by kindness from carrying out GOD’s law, if you truly believe in GOD and the Last Day. And let a group of believers witness their punishment.*
Dipnot: *24:2 Social pressure, i.e., public witnessing of the punishment, is the basic punishment (see also 5:38). The lashes shall be symbolic, not severe.

Ayet: The adulterer will end up marrying an adulteress or an idol worshiper, and the adulteress will end up marrying an adulterer or an idol worshiper. This is prohibited for the believers.
Those who accuse married women of adultery, then fail to produce four witnesses, you shall whip them eighty lashes, and do not accept any testimony from them. These are the wicked ones.
However, if they repent afterwards, and reform, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
As for those who accuse their own spouses, without any other witnesses, then the testimony may be accepted if he swears by GOD four times that he is telling the truth.
And the fifth oath shall be to incur GOD’s condemnation upon him, if he was lying.
She shall be considered innocent if she swears by GO D four times that he is a liar.
And the fifth oath shall be to incur GOD s wrath upon her if he was telling the truth.
This is GOD’s grace and mercy towards you. GOD is Redeemer, Most Wise.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: A gang among you produced a big lie.* Do not think that it was bad for you; in fact, it was good for you (as a lesson). Meanwhile, each one of them has earned his share of the guilt. And the one who initiated the whole incident has incurred a terrible retribution.
Dipnot: *24:11 This refers to a historical incident where the Prophet’s wife Aysha was left in the desert by mistake, and found by a young man who helped her catch up with the Prophet’s caravan. This triggered the famous (Big Lie’ against Aysha.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: When you heard it, the believers should have had better thoughts about themselves, and should have said, “This is obviously a big lie.”

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: You should have demanded four witnesses. If the witnesses were not produced, then they are, according to GOD, liars.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: If it were not for GOD’s grace towards you, and His mercy in this world and in the Hereafter, you would have suffered a great retribution because of this incident.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: You fabricated it with your own tongues, and the rest of you repeated it with your mouths without proof. You thought it was simple, when it was, according to GOD, gross.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: When you heard it, you should have said, “We will not repeat this. Glory be to You. This is a gross lie.”

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: GOD admonishes you that you shall never do this again, if you are really believers.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: GOD thus explains the revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: Those who love to see immorality spread among the believers have incurred a painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter. GOD knows, while you do not know.

Pasaj Başlığı: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
Ayet: GOD showers you with His grace and mercy. GOD is Most Kind towards the believers, Most Merciful.

O you who believe, do not follow the steps of Satan, for anyone who follows the steps of Satan will be led to evil and vice. If it were not for GOD s grace towards you, and His mercy, none of you would have been purified. But GOD purifies whomever He wills. GOD is Hearer, Knower.

Let those among you who are blessed with resources and wealth give to their relatives, the poor, and to those who have immigrated for the sake of GOD. They shall forgive and forget; do you not love to attain GOD’s forgiveness? GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
Surely, those who falsely accuse married women who are pious believers have incurred condemnation in this life and in the Hereafter; they have incurred a horrendous retribution.
The day will come when their own tongues, hands, and feet will bear witness to everything they had done.
On that day, GOD will pay them fully for their works, and they will find out that GOD is the Truth.

The bad women for the bad men, and the bad men for the bad women, and the good women for the good men, and the good men for the good women. The latter are innocent of such accusations (as the Big Lie). They have attained forgiveness and a generous reward.
O you who believe, do not enter homes other than yours without permission from their inhabitants, and without greeting them. This is better for you, that you may take heed.
If you find no one in them, then do not enter them until you obtain permission. If you are told, “Go back,” you must go back, for it is purer for you. GOD is fully aware of everything you do.
You commit no error by entering uninhabited homes wherein there is something that belongs to you. GOD knows everything you reveal, as well as everything you conceal.
Tell the believing men that they shall subdue their eyes (and not stare at the women), and to maintain their chastity. This is purer for them. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything they do.
Dipnot: *24:30-31 Dressing modestly, therefore, is a trait of the believing men and women. The minimum requirements for a woman’s dress is to lengthen her garment (33:59) and to cover her chest. Tyrannical Arab traditions have given a false impression that a woman must be covered from head to toe; such is not a Quranic or Islamic dress.

Ayet: And tell the believing women to subdue their eyes, and maintain their chastity. They shall not reveal any parts of their bodies, except that which is necessary—they shall cover their chests. They shall not relax this code in the presence of other than their husbands, their fathers, the fathers of their husbands, their sons, the sons of their husbands their brothers, the sons of their brothers, the sons of their sisters, other women, the servants or employees who have no sexual drive, or the children who have not reached puberty. They shall not strike their feet when they walk in order to shake and reveal certain details of their bodies. All of you shall repent to GOD, O you believers, that you may succeed.*
