Ayet: He will then correct your works, and forgive your sins. Those who obey GOD and His messenger have triumphed a great triumph.

We have offered the responsibility (freedom of choice) to the heavens and the earth, and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were afraid of it. But the human being accepted it; he was transgressing, ignorant.*
Dipnot: *33:72 See Appendix 7.

Ayet: For GOD will inevitably punish the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, and the idol worshiping men and the idol worshiping women. GOD redeems the believing men and the believing women. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
Praise be to GOD, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. All praise is due to Him in the Hereafter, and He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

He knows everything that goes into the earth, and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky, and everything that climbs into it. And He is the Most Merciful, the Forgiving.

Those who disbelieved said, “The Hour will never come to pass!” Say, “Absolutely, by my Lord, it will inevitably come to you. He is the Knower of the future. Not even the equivalent of an atom’s weight is hidden from Him, be it in the heavens or the earth. Not even smaller than that, or larger (is hidden). All are in a profound record.”
Most assuredly, He will recompense those who believe and lead a righteous life. They have deserved forgiveness and a generous provision.
As for those who constantly challenge our revelations, they have incurred a retribution of painful humiliation.
It is evident to those who are blessed with knowledge that this revelation from your Lord to you is indeed the truth, and that it guides to the path of the Almighty, the Most Praised.
Those who disbelieved said, “We can show you a man who tells you that after you are torn apart you will be created anew.
“Is he fabricating lies about GOD, or is he crazy?” Indeed, those who disbelieve in the Hereafter have incurred the worst retribution, for they have gone far astray.

Have they not seen all the things in front of them and behind them, in the heaven and the earth? If we willed, we could have caused the earth to swallow them, or caused masses to fall on them from the sky. This is a sign for every obedient servant.
We endowed David with blessings from us: “O mountains, submit with him, and you too, O birds.” We softened the iron for him.
“You may make shields that fit perfectly, and work righteousness. I am Seer of everything you do.”

And to Solomon we committed the wind in his service, traveling one month coming and one month going. And we caused a spring of oil to gush out for him. Also, the jinns worked for him, by his Lord’s leave. Any one of them who disregarded our commands, we subjected him to a severe punishment.
They made for him anything he wanted—niches, statues, deep pools, and heavy cooking pots. O family of David, work (righteousness) to show your appreciation—only a few of My servants are appreciative.

When the appointed time for his death came, they had no clue that he had died. It was only when one of the animals knocked away his staff, and he fell down, that the jinns realized that he was dead. They also realized that if they really knew the unseen, they would have stopped working so hard when he died.
Sheba’s homeland used to be a marvel, with two gardens on the right and the left. Eat from your Lord’s provisions, and be appreciative of Him. Good land, and a forgiving Lord.
They turned away and, consequently, we poured upon them a disastrous flood, and we substituted their two gardens into two gardens of bad tasting fruits, thorny plants, and a small yield.
We thus requited them for their disbelief. Do we not requite the disbeliever?
We placed between them and the communities that we blessed other oases, and we secured the journey between them: “Travel therein days and nights in complete security.”

But they (turned unappreciative and) challenged: “Our Lord, we do not care if You increase the distances of our journeys (without any stations).” They thus wronged their own souls. Consequently, we made them history, and scattered them into small communities throughout the land. This should provide lessons for those who are steadfast, appreciative.
Satan found them readily fulfilling his expectations. They followed him, except a few believers.
He never had any power over them. But we thus distinguish those who believe in the Hereafter from those who are doubtful about it. Your Lord is in full control of all things.

Say, “Implore the idols you set up besides GOD. They do not possess as much as a single atom in the heavens, nor the earth. They possess no partnership therein, nor does He use any of them as an assistant.”

Intercession with Him is in vain, unless it coincides with His will. When their minds are finally settled down, and they ask, “What did your Lord say,” they will say, “The truth.” He is the Most High, the Most Great
Say, “Who provides for you, from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “GOD,” and “Either we or you are guided, or far astray.”
Say, “You are not responsible for our crimes, nor are we responsible for what you do.”
Say, “Our Lord will summon all of us then He will judge between us truthfully. He is the Judge, the Knower.”
Say, “Show me the idols you set up as partners with Him!” Say, “No; He is the one GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.”
We have sent you (O Rashad)* to all the people, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner, but most people do not know.
Dipnot: *34:28 As detailed in Appendix 2, the name of this messenger is mathematically coded into the Quran as “Rashad Khalifa.” By adding the numerical value of the name “Rashad” (505), plus the numerical value of the name “Khalifa” (725), plus the number of the sura (34), plus the number of the verse (28), we obtain a total that conforms with the Quran’s 19-based mathematical miracle, which was unveiled through Rashad. (505+ 725+34+28=1292=19x68). More information is given in 5:19 and its footnote. 2056,

Ayet: They challenge, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
Say, “You have a specific time, on a specific day, that you cannot delay by one hour, nor advance.”

Those who disbelieved said, “We will not believe in this Quran, nor in the previous scriptures.” If you could only envision these transgressors when they stand before their Lord! They will argue with one another back and forth. The followers will tell their leaders, “If it were not for you, we would have been believers.”
The leaders said to those who followed them, “Are we the ones who diverted you from the guidance after it came to you? No; it is you who were criminals.”

The followers said to their leaders, “It was you who schemed night and day, then commanded us to be unappreciative of GOD, and to set up idols to rank with Him.” They became ridden with remorse, when they saw the retribution. We placed shackles around the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they not justly requited for whatever they did?
Every time we sent a warner to a community, the leaders of that community said, “We reject the message you are sent with.”
They also said, “We are more powerful, with more money and children; we will not be punished.”
Say, “My Lord grants the provision for whomever He wills, and reduces it, but most people do not know.”

It is not your money or your children that will bring you closer to us. Only those who believe and lead a righteous life will receive the reward for their works, multiplied manyfold. In the abode of Paradise they will live in security.
As for those who consistently challenge our revelations, they will abide in retribution.
Say, “My Lord increases the provision for whomever He chooses from among His servants, and reduces it. Anything you spend (in the cause of God), He will pay you for it; He is the Best Provider.”
On the day when He summons them all, He will say to the angels, “Did these people worship you?”
They will answer, “Be You glorified. You are our Lord and Master, not them. Instead, they were worshiping the jinns; most of them were believers therein.”
On that day, you will not possess any power to help one another, or harm one another. We will say to the transgressors, “Suffer the retribution of Hell, which you used to deny.”

When our revelations are recited to them, perfectly clear, they say, “This is simply a man who wants to divert you from the way your parents used to worship.” They also say, “This is no more than fabricated lies.” And those who disbelieved said about the truth when it came to them, “This is obviously magic.”
We did not give them any scriptures to study, nor did we send to them before you a warner.

Pasaj Başlığı:
Mathematical Miracle of the Quran
Greater Than All Previous Miracles*
Ayet: Consequently, they were deprived of everything they longed for. This was also the fate of their likes in the previous generations. They harbored too many doubts.

Praise be to GOD, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, and appointer of the angels to be messengers with wings—two, three, and four (wings). He increases the creation as He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.
When GOD showers any people with mercy, no force can stop it. And if He withholds it, no force, other than He, can send it. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.
O people, remember GOD’s blessings upon you. Is there any creator other than GOD who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?
If they disbelieve you, messengers before you have been disbelieved. GOD is in control of all things.
O people, GOD’s promise is truth; do not be distracted by this lowly life. Do not be diverted from GOD by an illusion.
The devil is your enemy, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be the dwellers of Hell.
Those who disbelieved have incurred a severe retribution, and those who believed and led a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.

What if one’s evil work is adorned in his eyes, until he thinks it is righteous? GOD thus sends astray whomever He wills, and He guides whomever He wills. Therefore, do not grieve over them. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.
GOD is the One who sends the winds, to stir up clouds, then we drive them towards barren lands, and revive such lands after they were dead. Thus is the resurrection.

Anyone seeking dignity should know that to GOD belongs all dignity. To Him ascends the good words, and He exalts the righteous works. As for those who scheme evil works, they incur severe retribution; the scheming of such people is destined to fail.

GOD created you from dust, then from a tiny drop, then He caused you to reproduce through your spouses. No female becomes pregnant, nor gives birth, without His knowledge. No one survives for a long life, and no one’s life is snapped short, except in accordance with a pre-existing record. This is easy for GOD.

And the two seas are not the same; one is fresh and potable, while the other is salty and undrinkable. From each of them you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry to wear. And you see the ships sailing therein, seeking His bounties, that you may be appreciative.
Dipnot: *35:12-13 When we send our astronauts into space, we provide them with their minimum needs of food, water, and oxygen. When we sided with Satan’s blasphemy billions of years ago (Appendix 7), God launched us into space aboard the spaceship Earth. But God has supplied our spaceship Earth with awesome renewable systems that provide a great variety of fresh foods, water, oxygen, and even the reproduction of us astronauts.

Ayet: If you call on them, they cannot hear you. Even if they hear you, they cannot respond to you. On the Day of Resurrection, they disown you. None informs you like the Most Cognizant.
Dipnot: *35:14 People idolize Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and/or the saints; such idols are dead, unaware, and utterly powerless. Even when they were alive, they were powerless.

Ayet: O people, you are the ones who need GOD, while GOD is in no need, Most Praiseworthy.
If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute a new creation.
This is not too difficult for GOD.

No soul can carry the sins of another soul. If a soul that is loaded with sins implores to have part of its load removed, no other soul can carry any part of it, even if they are related. The only people to heed your warnings are those who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and observe the contact prayers (Salat). Whoever purifies his soul, does so for his own good. To GOD is the final destiny.
The blind and the seer are not equal.
Nor are the darkness and the light.
Nor are the coolness and the heat.
Nor are the living and the dead; GOD causes whomever He wills to hear. You cannot make hearers out of those in the graves.
You are no more than a warner.
We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner. Every community must receive a warner.
If they disbelieve you, those before them have also disbelieved. Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, and the Psalms, and the enlightening scriptures.
Subsequently, I punished those who disbelieved; how terrible was My retribution!

Do you not realize that GOD sends down from the sky water, whereby we produce fruits of various colors? Even the mountains have different colors; the peaks are white, or red, or some other color. And the ravens are black.
Also, the people, the animals, and the livestock come in various colors. This is why the people who truly reverence GOD are the knowledgeable. GOD is Almighty, Forgiving.
Surely, those who recite the book of GOD, observe the contact prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them they spend secretly and publicly, are engaged in an enterprise that never fails.
For He will pay them generously, and will multiply His bounties to them. He is Forgiving, Appreciative.

Pasaj Başlığı: Quran: The Consummation of All the Scriptures
Ayet: What we revealed to you in this scripture is the truth, consummating all previous scriptures. GOD is fully Cognizant of His servants, Seer.

Pasaj Başlığı: Quran: The Consummation of All the Scriptures
Ayet: We passed the scripture from generation to generation, and we let whomever we chose from among our servants receive it. Subsequently, some of them wronged their souls, others upheld it only part of the time, while others were eager to work righteousness, in accordance with GOD’s will— this is the greatest triumph.
They will enter the gardens of Eden, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments will be made of silk.
They will say, “Praise GOD for removing all our worries. Our Lord is Forgiving, Appreciative.
“He has admitted us into the abode of eternal bliss, out of His grace. Never do we get bored herein, never do we get tired.”
As for those who disbelieved, they have incurred the fire of Hell, where they are never finished by death, nor is the retribution ever commuted for them. We thus requite those who are unappreciative.

They will scream therein, “Our Lord, if you get us out of here, we will work righteousness, instead of the works we used to do.” Did we not give you a life-long chance, with continuous reminders for those who would take heed? And the warner went to you. Therefore, suffer (the consequences). The transgressors will have no helpers.
GOD is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He is the Knower of all innermost thoughts.

He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth. Subsequently, whoever disbelieves does so to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers only increases their Lord’s abhorrence towards them. The disbelief of the disbelievers only plunges them deeper into loss.

Say, “Consider the idols you have set up besides GOD; show me what on earth have they created.” Do they own any partnership in the heavens? Have we given them a book wherein there is no doubt? Indeed, what the transgressors promise one another is no more than an illusion.
GOD is the One who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else is to hold them, they will most certainly vanish. He is Clement, Forgiving.
They swore by GOD solemnly that if a warner went to them, they would be better than any other congregation! Now that the warner did come to them, this only plunged them deeper into aversion.

They resorted to arrogance on earth, and evil scheming. However, evil schemes backfire on those who scheme them. Should they expect anything but the fate of those who did the same things in the past? You will find that GOD’s system is never changeable; you will Find that GOD’s system is immutable.

Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They were even stronger. Nothing can be hidden from GOD in the heavens, nor on earth. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.

If GOD were to punish the people for their sins, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined interim. Once their interim is fulfilled, then GOD is Seer of His servants.
Y.S.*

Pasaj Başlığı: Ridiculing The Messengers: A Tragic Human Trait*
Ayet: Every one of them will be summoned before us.
One sign for them is the dead land: we revive it and produce from it grains for their food.
And we grow in it gardens of date palms, and grapes. And we cause springs to gush out therein.
This is to provide them with fruits, and to let them manufacture what they need. Would they be thankful?
Glory be to the One who created all kinds of plants from the earth, as well as themselves, and other creations that they do not even know.
Another sign for them is the night: we remove the daylight therefrom, whereupon they are in darkness.
And the sun sets into a specific location, according to the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.
And the moon we designed in stages, until it becomes like an old curved sheath.
The sun is never to catch up with the moon, nor does the night precede the day. Each of them is floating in its own orbit.
Another sign for them is that we carried their forefathers on the loaded ark.
Then created the same for them to ride in.
If we willed, we could have drowned them, so that their screaming would not be heard, nor could they be saved.
Instead, we shower them with mercy, and let them enjoy for awhile.
Yet, when they are told, “Learn from your past, to work righteousness for your future that you may attain mercy,”
No matter what kind of sign is sent to them from their Lord, they consistently disregard it.

And when they are told, “Give from GOD’s provisions to you,” those who disbelieved say to those who believed, “Why should we give to those whom GOD could feed, if He so willed? You are really far astray.”
They also challenged, “When will that promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
All they see will be one blow that overwhelms them, while they dispute.
They will not even have time to make a will, nor will they return to their people.
The horn will be blown, whereupon they will rise from the grave and go to their Lord.
They will say, “Woe to us. Who resurrected us from our death? This is what the Most Gracious has promised. The messengers were right.”
All it takes is one blow, whereupon they are summoned before us.
On that day, no soul will be wronged in the least. You will be paid precisely for whatever you did.
The dwellers of Paradise will be, on that day, happily busy.
They abide with their spouses in beautiful shade, enjoying comfortable furnishings.
They will have fruits therein; they will have anything they wish.
Greetings of peace from a Most Merciful Lord.
As for you, O guilty ones, you will be set aside.
Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not worship the devil? That he is your most ardent enemy?
That you shall worship Me alone? That this is the straight path?
He has misled multitudes of you. Did you not possess any understanding?
This is the Hell that was promised for you.
Today you will burn in it, as a consequence of your disbelief.
On that day we will seal their mouths and their hands and feet will bear witness to everything they had done.
If we will, we can veil their eyes and thus, when they seek the path, they will not see.
If we will, we can freeze them in place; thus, they can neither move forward, nor go back.
Whomever we permit to live for a long time, we revert him to weakness. Do they not understand?
We did not teach him (the messenger) poetry, nor should he. This is but a reminder; a profound Quran.
To warn everyone alive, and to expose the disbelievers.
Have they not seen that we created for them, with our own hands, livestock that they own?
And we subdued them for them; some of them they ride, and some they eat.
They derive other benefits from them, as well as drinks. Would they not be appreciative?
They set up besides GOD other gods, perhaps they help them!
On the contrary, they cannot help them; they end up serving them as devoted soldiers.
Therefore, do not be saddened by their utterances. We are fully aware of everything they conceal and everything they declare.
Does the human being not see that we created him from a tiny drop, then he turns into a profound enemy'
And he posed a question to us, while forgetting his own creation: “Who can resurrect the bones after they had rotted?”
Say, “The One who initiated them in the first place will resurrect them. He is fully aware of every creation.”
He is the One who creates for you, from the green trees, fuel which you burn for light.
Is not the One who created the heavens and the earth able to recreate the same? Yes indeed; He is the Creator, the Omniscient.
All He needs to do to carry out any command is say to it, “Be,” and it is.
Therefore, glory be to the One in whose hand is the kingship over all things, and to Him you will be returned.
By the arrangers in columns.
And the blamers of those to be blamed.
And the reciters of the messages.
Your god is only one.
The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, and Lord of the easts.
We have adorned the lowest heaven with beautiful stars.
And guarded it from every evil devil.
They cannot spy on the high society; they get shot from every side.
They are doomed; they have incurred an eternal retribution.
If any of them ventures to charge the outer limits, he gets struck with a fierce projectile.
Ask them, “Are they more difficult to create, or our other creations?” We created them from wet mud.
While you are awed, they mock.
When reminded, they take no heed.
When they see proof, they ridicule it.
They say, “This is obviously magic!
“After we die and become dust and bones, do we get resurrected?
“Even our ancient ancestors?”
Say, “Yes, you will be forced.”
All it takes is one nudge, whereupon they (stand up) looking.
They will say, “Woe to us; this is the Day of Judgment.”
This is the day of decision that you used to disbelieve in.
Summon the transgressors, and their spouses, and the idols they worshiped—
besides GOD; guide them to the path of Hell.
Stop them, and ask them:
“Why do you not help one another?”
They will be, on that day, totally submitting.
They will blame one another.
They will say (to their leaders), “You used to come to us from the right side.”
They will respond, “It is you who were not believers.
“We never had any power over you; it is you who were transgressors.
“We incurred our Lord’s wrath, and now we have to suffer.
“We misled you, only because we were misled.”
Thus, they will all suffer the retribution on that day together.
This is how we requite the guilty.
When they were told, “Laa Elaaha Ella Allah [There is no other god besides GOD], they turned arrogant.
They said, “Shall we leave our gods for the sake of a crazy poet?”
In fact, he has brought the truth, and has confirmed the messengers.
Most assuredly, you will suffer the most painful retribution.
You only pay for what you did.
Only GOD’s servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (will be saved).
They have deserved provisions that are reserved specifically for them.
All kinds of fruits. They will be honored therein.
In the gardens of bliss.
On furnishings close to one another.
Enjoying cups of pure drinks.
Clear and delicious for the drinkers.
Never polluted, and never exhausted.
With them will be beautiful companions.
Protected like fragile eggs.

Pasaj Başlığı: The People of Heaven Visit the People of Hell
Ayet: Then they return to Hell.
They found their parents astray.
And blindly followed their footsteps.
Most of the previous generations also strayed in the same manner.
We have sent to them warners.
Note the consequences for those who have been warned.
Only GOD’s servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (are saved).
Thus, Noah called upon us, and we were the best responders.
We saved him and his family from the great disaster.
We made his progeny the survivors.
And we preserved his history for subsequent generations.
Peace be upon Noah throughout history.
We thus reward the pious.
He is one of our believing servants.
We drowned all the others.
Among his followers was Abraham.
He came to his Lord wholeheartedly.
He said to his father and his people “What are you worshiping?
“Is it these fabricated gods besides GOD that you want?
“What do you think of the Lord of the universe?”
He looked carefully at the stars.
He gave up: “I am tired of this!”
But they turned away from him.
He turned on their idols, saying, “Would you like to eat?
“Why do you not speak?”
He then destroyed them completely
They went to him in great anger.
He said, “How can you worship what you carve?
“When GOD has created you, and everything you make!”
They said, “Let us build a profound fire, and throw him into it.”
They schemed against him, but we made them the losers.
He said, “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.”
“My Lord, grant me righteous children.”
We gave him good news of a clement child.

When he grew enough to work with him, he said, “My son, I see in a dream that I must sacrifice you. What do you think?” He said, “O my father, do what you are commanded to do. You will find me, GOD willing, patient.”
They both submitted, and he put his forehead down (to sacrifice him).
We called him, “O Abraham.
“You have believed your own dream.” We thus reward the pious.
That was an exacting trial.
We ransomed (Ismail) by substituting an animal sacrifice.
And we preserved his history for subsequent generations.
Peace be upon Abraham.
We thus reward the righteous.
He is one of our believing servants.
Then we gave him the good news about the birth of Isaac, to be one of the righteous prophets.
We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants, some are righteous, and some are transgressors.
We blessed Moses and Aaron.
We delivered them and their people from the great disaster.
We supported them, and they became the winners.
We gave both of them the profound scripture.
We guided them in the right path.
We preserved their history for subsequent generations.
Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
We thus reward the pious.
Both of them were among our righteous servants.
Elias was one of the messengers.
He said to his people, “Would you not work righteousness?
“Do you worship a statue, instead of the best Creator?
“GOD; your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!”
They disbelieved him. Consequently, they had to pay.
Only GOD’s servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (are saved).
We preserved his history for subsequent generations.
Peace be upon Eliaseen.
We thus reward the pious.
He was one of our believing servants.
Lot was one of the messengers.
We saved him and all his family.
Only the old woman was doomed.
We annihilated the others.
You still pass by their ruins by day.
And by night. Do you understand?
Jonah was one of the messengers.
He escaped to the loaded ship.
He rebelled, and joined the losers.
The fish swallowed him, and he was the one to blame.
If it were not that he resorted to meditation (on God)—
he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection.
We had him thrown up into the desert, exhausted.
We had a tree of edible fruit grow for him.
We sent him to a hundred thousand, or more.
They did believe, and we let them enjoy this life.
Ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters, while you have sons?”
Did we create the angels to be females? Did they witness that?
Indeed, they blaspheme when they say—
“GOD begets;” they are liars.
Did He choose the girls over the boys?
What is wrong with your logic?
Why do you not take heed?

Pasaj Başlığı: The Believing Egyptian Debates With His People
Ayet: “Some day you will remember what I am telling you now. I leave the judgment of this matter to GOD; GOD is the Seer of all the people.”

Pasaj Başlığı: The Believing Egyptian Debates With His People
Ayet: GOD then protected him from their evil schemes. The people of Pharaoh have incurred the worst retribution.
The Hell will be shown to them day and night, and on the Day of Resurrection: “Admit Pharaoh’s people into the worst retribution.”
As they argue in Hell, the followers will say to their leaders, “We used to be your followers, can you spare us any part of this Hell?”
The leaders will say, “We are all in this together. GOD has judged among the people.”
Those in the fire will say to the guardians of Hell, “Call upon your Lord to reduce the retribution for us by one day.”

They will say, “Did you not receive your messengers who delivered to you clear messages?” They will reply, “Yes we did.” They will say, “Then implore (as much as you wish); the imploring of the disbelievers is always in vain.”
We will surely give victory to our messengers and to those who believe, both in this world and on the day the witnesses are summoned.
On that day, the apologies of the disbelievers will not benefit them. They have incurred condemnation; they have incurred the worst destiny.
We have given Moses the guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the scripture.
(Their history) is a lesson and a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
Therefore, be patient, for GOD’s promise is true, and ask forgiveness for your sins. You shall glorify and praise your Lord night and day.

Surely, those who argue against GOD’s revelations without proof are exposing the arrogance that is hidden inside them, and they are not even aware of it. Therefore, seek refuge in GOD; He is the Hearer, the Seer.
The creation of the heavens and the earth is even more awesome than the creation of the human being, but most people do not know.
Not equal are the blind and the seer. Nor are those who believe and work righteousness equal to the sinners. Rarely do you take heed.
Most certainly, the Hour is coming, no doubt about it, but most people do not believe.
Your Lord says, “Implore Me, and I will respond to you.” Surely, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Hell, forcibly.
Dipnot: *40:60 Supplication, imploring God for anything, even material luxuries, is a form of worship. Hence the commandment to implore God whenever we have any needs. An atheist will never implore God for anything.

Ayet: GOD is the One who designed the night so you can rest therein, and the day lighted. GOD bestows many blessings upon the people, but most people are not appreciative.
Such is GOD your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?
Thus are those who disregard GOD’s revelations caused to deviate.

GOD is the One who rendered the earth habitable for you, and the sky a structure. He is the One who designed you, and designed you well. He is the One who provides you with good provisions.* Such is GOD your Lord; Most Exalted is GOD, Lord of the universe.
He is the Living; there is no other god besides Him. You shall worship Him, devoting your religion absolutely to Him alone. Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

Their belief then could not help them in the least, once they saw our retribution. Such is GOD’s system that has been established to deal with His creatures; the disbelievers are always doomed.
H. M.*
A revelation from the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
A scripture whose verses have been precisely designed, in an Arabic Quran, for people who know.
A bearer of good news, as well as a warner. However, most of them turn away; they do not hear.
They said, “Our minds are made up, our ears are deaf to your message, and a barrier separates us from you. Do what you want, and so will we.”
Say, “I am no more than a human being like you, who has been inspired that your god is one god. You shall be devoted to Him, and ask His forgiveness. Woe to the idol worshipers.
“They do not give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers.”
As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a well deserved recompense.
Say, “You are disbelieving in the One who created the earth in two days,* and you set up idols to rival Him, the Lord of the universe.”
Dipnot: *41:9-10 The “days” of creation represent a yardstick. Thus, the physical universe was created in two days, while the calculation of provisions for all the creatures on earth required four. This also teaches us that there is life only on this planet Earth.

Ayet: He placed on it stabilizers (m ountains), and blessed it. And He measured precisely all its provisions, in four days, to satisfy the needs of all its inhabitants.
Dipnot: *41:9-10 The “days” of creation represent a yardstick. Thus, the physical universe was created in two days, while the calculation of provisions for all the creatures on earth required four. This also teaches us that there is life only on this planet Earth.

Ayet: Then He turned to the sky, when it was still gas, and said to it, and to the earth, “Come into existence, willingly or unwillingly.” They said, “We come willingly.”

Thus, He* completed the seven universes in two days, and set up the laws for every universe. And we* adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and placed guards therein. Such is the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.
Dipnot: *41:12 God alone created the universe (18:51), but the angels participated in handling certain jobs in the lowest universe. Our universe cannot stand the physical presence of God (7:143). The plural tense acknowledges the angels’ role in our universe (App. 10).

Ayet: If they turn away, then say, “I am warning you of a disaster like the disaster that annihilated Aad and Thamoud.”

Their messengers went to them, in front of them and behind them, saying, “You shall not worship except GOD.” They said, “Had our Lord willed, He could have sent angels. We are disbelievers in what you say.”

As for Aad, they turned arrogant on earth, without the truth, and said, “Who is more powerful than we?” Did they not realize that GOD, who created them, is more powerful than they? They were unappreciative of our revelations.

Consequently, we sent upon them violent wind, for a few miserable days to afflict them with a humiliating retribution in this life, and the retribution of the Hereafter is far more humiliating; they can never win.
As for Thamoud, we provided them with guidance, but they preferred blindness over guidance. Consequently, the disastrous and shameful retribution annihilated them, because of what they earned.
And we saved those who believed and led a righteous life.
The day will come when the enemies of GOD will be summoned to the hellfire, forcibly.
Once they get there, their own hearing, eyes, and skins will bear witness to everything they had done.

They will say to their skins, “Why did you bear witness against us?” They will reply, “GOD made us speak up; He is the One who causes everything to speak.” He is the One who created you the first time, and to Him you will be returned.
There is no way you can hide from your own hearing, your eyes, nor your skins. In fact, you thought that GOD was unaware of much of what you do.
Such thinking about your Lord is what caused your fall, and thus you became losers.
If they continue the way they are, Hell will be their destiny, and if they make up excuses, they will not be excused.
We assign to them companions who adorn everything they do in their eyes. Thus, they end up incurring the same fate as the communities who preceded them of jinns and humans, who were also losers.
Those who disbelieved said, “Do not listen to this Quran and distort it, that you may win.”
Consequently, we will afflict these disbelievers with a severe retribution. We simply requite them for their evil works.
Such is the requital for GOD’s enemies. Hell will be their eternal abode; a requital for discarding our revelations.
Those who disbelieved will say, “Our Lord, show us those among the two kinds—jinns and humans— who misled us, so we can trample them under our feet, and render them the lowliest.”
Those who say, “Our Lord is GOD,” then lead a righteous life, the angels descend upon them: “Have no fear, nor shall you grieve, and know the good news that Paradise has been reserved for you.
“We are your allies in this life, and in the Hereafter. You will have in it anything you wish for; you will have anything you want.
“(Such is your) ultimate abode, from the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”
Who can utter better statements than one who invites to GOD, works righteousness, and says, “I am one of the submitters (Muslims)!”
Not equal is the good response and the bad response. You shall resort to the nicest possible response. Thus, the one who used to be your enemy, may become your best friend.
None can attain this except one who steadfastly perseveres. None can attain this except one who is extremely fortunate.
When the devil whispers an idea to you, you shall seek refuge in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

Among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not fall prostrate before the sun, nor the moon, and fall prostrate before GOD, who created them, if you truly worship Him alone.
If they are too arrogant to do this, then those at your Lord glorify Him night and day, without ever tiring.
Among His signs is that you see the land still, then, as soon as we shower it with water it vibrates with life. Surely, the One who revived it can revive the dead. He is Omnipotent.

Surely, those who distort our revelations are not hidden from us. Is one who gets thrown into Hell better, or one who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; He is Seer of everything you do.

Pasaj Başlığı: No Falsehood Can Enter The Quran*
Ayet: Those who have rejected the message when it came to them, have rejected an Honorable book.

Pasaj Başlığı: No Falsehood Can Enter The Quran*
Ayet: No falsehood can ever enter it, from its front, nor its back;* a revelation from a Most Wise, Praiseworthy.
Dipnot: *41:42 The Quran’s formidable mathematical composition guarantees that any addition, deletion, or distortion of a single letter or any other element in the Quran, is exposed and utterly rejected. The one attempt by idolizers of the Prophet to inject two false verses was thus exposed. The “pure” Quran always existed. See Appendices 1 & 24.

Pasaj Başlığı: No Falsehood Can Enter The Quran*
Ayet: What is said to you is precisely what was said to the previous messengers. Your Lord possesses forgiveness, and He also possesses painful retribution.

If we made it a non-Arabic Quran they would have said, “Why did it come down in that language?” Whether it is in Arabic or non- Arabic, say, “For those who believe, it is a guide and healing (regardless of their language). As for those who disbelieve, they will be deaf and blind to it, as if they are being addressed from a faraway place.”

We have given Moses the scripture (in Hebrew), and it was also disputed. If it were not for your Lord’s predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, they harbor many doubts.
Whoever works righteousness, does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. Your Lord is never unjust towards the people.

Knowledge about the Hour is with Him.* No fruits emerge from their sheaths, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. The day will come when He asks them: “Where are those idols that you set up besides Me?” They will say, “We proclaim to You that none of us bears witness to that.”
Dipnot: *41:47 See Appendix 25.

Ayet: The idols they had idolized will disown them, and they will realize that there is no escape.
The human being never tires of imploring for good things. And when adversity befalls him, he turns despondent, desperate.

Then, when we bless him after suffering some adversity, he says, “This belongs to me. I do not believe that the Hour will ever come to pass. Even if I am returned to my Lord, I will find at Him better things.” Most certainly, we will inform the disbelievers of all their works, and will afflict them with severe retribution.
When we bless the human being, he turns and drifts farther and farther away. But as soon as he suffers an affliction, he implores loudly.
Say, “What if this is from GOD, and you reject it? Who is farther astray than one who opposes this?”
We will show them our signs in the horizons, and within themselves, until they realize that this is the truth. Is your Lord not sufficient? He witnesses all things.*
Dipnot: *41:53 As detailed in Appendix 1, God has provided physical, verifiable, perpetual, and utterly irrefutable proof that this Quran is divine truth. This great prophecy, together with 9:33, 48:28, 61:9 & 110:2 inform us that the whole world is destined to accept the Quran as God’s unaltered message to the world. God witnesses the future (App. 38).

Ayet: They harbor doubts about meeting their Lord, and He is fully aware of all things.
H.M.*

Ayet: Inspiring you, and those before you, is GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.
To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and He is the Most High, the Great.
The heavens above them almost shatter out of reverence for Him, and the angels praise and glorify their Lord, and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Absolutely, GOD is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
Those who set up other lords besides Him, GOD is the One in charge of them; you are not their advocate.
We thus revealed to you an Arabic Quran to warn the central community and all around it, and to warn about the Day of Summoning that is inevitable. Some will be in Heaven, and some will be in Hell.
Had GOD willed, He could have made them one community. But He redeems into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the transgressors, they have no master, nor a helper.
Did they find other lords besides Him? GOD is the only Lord, and He is the One who resurrects the dead, and He is the Omnipotent One.
If you dispute any part of this message, the judgment for doing this rests with GOD. Such is GOD my Lord. In Him I trust, and to Him I submit.

He is the Initiator of the heavens and the earth. He created for you, from among you, spouses, and created for the livestock mates, in order to multiply. There is nothing that equals Him. He is the Hearer, the Seer.
To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth. He increases the provision for whomever He wills, and reduces it. He is fully aware of all things.

He decreed for you the same religion He decreed for Noah, and what we inspired to you, and what we decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: “You shall uphold this one religion, and do not divide it.” Monotheists w Idol Worshipers The idol worshipers will resent what you invite them to do. GOD redeems to Himself whomever He wills; He guides to Himself everyone who submits.

Ironically, they broke up into sects—only after the knowledge had come to them—due to jealousy and resentment among themselves. If it were not for a predetermined decision from your Lord to respite them for a definite interim, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, these later generations who inherited the scripture are full of doubts.

GOD will gather us all together; to Him is the ultimate destiny.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Message to the Christians and the Jews
Ayet: Those who argue about GOD with people who have responded to Him, their argument is nullified at their Lord, they have incurred wrath, and have deserved a severe retribution.

Pasaj Başlığı: Message to the Christians and the Jews
Ayet: GOD is the One who sent down the scripture, bringing the truth and the law. For all that you know, the Hour may be very close.

Ayet: Challenging it are those who do not believe in it. As for those who believe, they are concerned about it, and know that it is the truth. Absolutely, those who deny the Hour (the Day of Judgment) have gone far astray.

Pasaj Başlığı: Message to the Christians and the Jews
Ayet: GOD is Compassionate towards His creatures; He provides for whomever He wills. He is the Powerful, the Almighty.

Pasaj Başlığı: Message to the Christians and the Jews
Ayet: Whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we multiply the rewards for him. And whoever seeks the materials of this world, we give him therefrom, while reserving no share for him in the Hereafter.

They follow idols who decree for them religious laws never authorized by GOD. If it were not for the predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the transgressors have incurred a painful retribution.*
Dipnot: *42:21 The Islam of today’s “Muslim” world has been so distorted, it has become a Satanic cult. The Ulama, or religious scholars, have added too many extraneous laws, prohibitions, dress codes, dietary regulations, and religious practices never authorized by God. This is why God’s Messenger of the Covenant was sent (9:31, 33:67, App. 33).

Ayet: You will see the transgressors worried about what they earned, and for sure it will afflict them. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they will be in the gardens of Paradise. They receive whatever they wish at their Lord. This is the great blessing.

This is the good news from GOD to His servants who believe and lead a righteous life. Say, “I do not ask you for any money. All I ask is that each of you shall take care of his own relatives.” Anyone who performs a righteous work, we multiply his reward for it. GOD is Forgiver, Appreciative.

Ayet: Are they saying, “He fabricated lies about GOD!?” If GOD willed, He could have sealed your mind. GOD erases what is wrong,* and fixes the truth of His words. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

Ayet: And He is the One who sends down the rain after they had despaired, and spreads His mercy. He is the only Master, the Praiseworthy.

Ayet: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and all the creatures He spread in them. He is certainly able to summon them all, if He so wills.
Any disaster that afflicts you is a consequence of something you have done. And He overlooks many (of your sins).
You can never escape, and you have none besides GOD as Master and Helper.
Among His signs are the ships that sail the ocean like flags.
If He willed, He could have stilled the winds, leaving them motionless on top of the water. These are signs for those who are steadfast, appreciative.
Or He could have annihilated them as a consequence of their own works. Instead, He overlooks many (of their sins).
Those who argue against our signs should know that they have no basis.
Whatever you are given is no more than temporary material of this world What GOD reserves is far better and everlasting, for those who believe and trust in their Lord.
They avoid gross sins and vice, and when angered they forgive.

And they respond to their Lord by observing the contact prayers (Salat), and by deciding their affairs on the basis of consultation among themselves, and from our provisions to them they give (to charity).
When injustice befalls them, they stand up for their rights.
Although the requital for an evil work is an equivalent retribution, those who pardon and maintain right eousness are rewarded by GOD. He does not love the unjust.
Certainly, those who stand up for their rights, when injustice befalls them, are not committing any error.
Committing errors are those who treat the people unjustly, and resort to aggression without provocation. These have incurred a painful retribution.
However, maintaining patience and forgiveness reflects a strength of character.
Whomever GOD sends astray will never find another protector, and you will see such transgressors, when they see the retribution, saying, “Can we get another chance?”

You will see them facing it, humiliated and debased, and looking but trying to avoid looking. Those who believed will proclaim: “The real losers are those who lost their souls and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Certainly, the transgressors have incurred an eternal retribution.”
They will find no allies to help them against GOD. Whomever GOD sends astray can never be guided.
You shall respond to your Lord before a day comes which is made inevitable by GOD. There will be no refuge for you on that day, nor an advocate.

If they turn away, we did not send you as their guardian. Your sole mission is delivering the message. When we shower the human being with mercy, he becomes proud, and when adversity afflicts him, as a consequence of his own deeds, the human being turns unappreciative.
To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills, granting daughters to whomever He wills, and granting sons to whomever He wills.
Or, He may have the males and the females marry each other, then render whomever He wills sterile. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.
No human being can communicate with GOD except through inspiration, or from behind a barrier, or by His sending of a messenger through whom He reveals what He wills. He is the Most High, Most Wise.

We inspired to you a revelation proclaiming our commandments—you had no idea about the scripture, or faith—and we made it a beacon to guide whomever we choose from among our servants. Surely, you guide to a straight path.
The path of GOD, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Absolutely, all matters are controlled by GOD.
H. M.*
