Ayet: And the profound scripture.
We have rendered it an Arabic Quran, that you may understand.*
Dipnot: *43:3 Arabic is the most efficient language, especially in expressing commandments., statutes and exacting laws. Hence the revelation of the Quran in Arabic for the clear understanding of all peoples, regardless of their tongues. See Appendix 4 for the details.

Ayet: It is preserved with us in the original master, honorable and full of wisdom
Should we just ignore the fact that you have transgressed?
Many a prophet we have sent to the previous generations.
Every time a prophet went to them, they ridiculed him.
Consequently, we annihilated people who were even more powerful than these. We thus set the examples from the previous communities.
If you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth,” they would say, “The Almighty, the Omniscient has created them.”
He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and created for you roads therein, that you may be guided.
And He is the One who sends down from the sky water, in exact measure, to revive dead lands therewith. Similarly, you will be resurrected.
And He is the One who created all kinds, in pairs (male and female). And He created for you ships and livestock to ride.
As you rest on top of them, you shall appreciate this blessing from your Lord, and say, “Glory be to the One who subdued this for us. We could not have controlled them by ourselves.
“We ultimately return to our Lord.”
They even assigned for Him a share from His own creation! Surely, the human being is profoundly unappreciative.
Has He chosen from among His creations daughters for Himself, while blessing you with sons?
When one of them is given news (of a daughter) as they claimed for the Most Gracious, his face is darkened with misery; he becomes despondent.
(They say,) “What is good about an offspring which is brought up to be beautiful, and cannot help in war?”
They claimed that the angels, who are creations of the Most Gracious, are females! Have they witnessed their creation? Their claims will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
They also said, “If the Most Gracious willed, we would not have worshiped them.” They certainly have no basis for such a claim. They only conjecture.*
Dipnot: *43:20 The idol worshipers cannot blame God for their idolatry, since we have absolute freedom of choice to worship God alone, or not.

Ayet: Have we given them a book before this, that they are upholding?
Instead, they said, “We found our parents carrying on certain practices, and we are following in their footsteps.”
Invariably, when we sent a warner to a community, the leaders therein said, “We found our parents following certain practices, and we will continue in their footsteps.”
He would say, “What if I brought to you better guidance than what you inherited from your parents?” They would say, “We are disbelievers in the message you brought.”
Therefore, we requited them; note the consequences for the rejectors.
Abraham said to his father and his people, “I disown what you worship.
“Only the One who created me can guide me.”
After him, He made this example (of Abraham) an everlasting lesson for subsequent generations, that they may redeem themselves.
Indeed, I have given these people and their forefathers sufficient chances, then the truth came to them, and a clarifying messenger.
When the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we are disbelievers therein.”
They said, “If only this Quran was sent down through another man from the two communities (Mecca or Yathrib) who is prominent!”

Are they the ones who assign your Lord’s mercy? We have assigned their shares in this life, raising some of them above others in ranks, in order to let them serve one another. However, the mercy from your Lord is far better than any material they may hoard.

Pasaj Başlığı: Materials of This World: All That The Disbelievers Get
Ayet: If it were not that all the people might become one (disbelieving) congregation, we would have granted everyone who disbelieves in the Most Gracious mansions with silver roofs, and stairs upon which they could climb.

Pasaj Başlığı: Materials of This World: All That The Disbelievers Get
Ayet: And gates for their mansions, and luxurious furnishings.

Pasaj Başlığı: Materials of This World: All That The Disbelievers Get
Ayet: And many vanities. All these are the temporary materials of this lowly life. The Hereafter, at your Lord, is far better for the righteous.
Anyone who disregards the message of the Most Gracious, we appoint a devil to be his constant companion.*
Dipnot: *43:36-39 Each one of us has a representative of Satan as a constant companion, within the same body. Unless we convert our companions, they continue to be devils (App. 7).

Ayet: Such companions will divert them from the path. Yet, they make them believe that they are guided.
Dipnot: *43:36-39 Each one of us has a representative of Satan as a constant companion, within the same body. Unless we convert our companions, they continue to be devils (App. 7).

Ayet: Then, when he comes to us he will say, “Oh I wish you were as far from me as the distance between the two easts. What a miserable companion!”
Dipnot: *43:36-39 Each one of us has a representative of Satan as a constant companion, within the same body. Unless we convert our companions, they continue to be devils (App. 7).

Ayet: It will not console you on that day, since you have transgressed, that both of you will share in the retribution.
Dipnot: *43:36-39 Each one of us has a representative of Satan as a constant companion, within the same body. Unless we convert our companions, they continue to be devils (App. 7).

Ayet: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind and the wicked strayers?
Whether we let you die before it or not, we will surely punish them.
And we may show you (the retribution) we promised for them. We are in full control over them.
Therefore, you shall steadfastly uphold what we have given you; you are in the right path.
This is a message for you and your people, and you will be questioned.
Ask all those messengers that we sent before you: “Have we set up besides the Most Gracious other gods to be worshiped?”
For example, we sent Moses with our miracles to Pharaoh and his elders, saying, “I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.”
When he showed them our miracles, they laughed at them.
Every sign we showed them was even bigger than the previous one, and we afflicted them with the plagues, perhaps they repent.
They said, “O magician, implore your Lord on our behalf, since you are closer to Him (to relieve this plague)-, we will then be guided.”
But as soon as we relieved their affliction, they reverted.
Pharaoh announced to his people, “O my people, do I not possess the kingship of Egypt, and these rivers are flowing under me? Do you not see?
“Which one is better; me or that one who is lowly and can hardly speak?
“Why does he not possess a treasure of gold, or bring the angels to work with him?”
He thus fooled his people, and they obeyed him; for they were wicked people.
When they persisted in fighting us, we punished them and drowned them all.
We rendered them an example and a lesson for the others.
And when the son of Mary was cited as an example, your people immediately rejected it.
They said, “Is it better to worship our gods, or to worship him?” They said this only to argue with you. Indeed, they are people in opposition.
He was no more than a human servant whom we blessed, and we rendered him a lesson for the Children of Israel.
If we willed, we could have made you angels colonizing the earth.

Pasaj Başlığı: Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World*
Ayet: He is to serve as a sign for knowing the end of the world.* You shall harbor no doubts about it, and follow me. This is the right path.
Dipnot: *43:61 As detailed in Appendix 25, the End of the World is given in the Quran, and the birthdate of Jesus provided one of the significant signs that the calculations are correct. We learn that the world will end in the year 2280 (19x120) after the birth of Jesus. See 47:18. Additionally, both the lunar year (1710) & the solar year (2280) are divisible by 570 (19x30), the number of years from the birth of Jesus to the birth of Muhammad.

Pasaj Başlığı: Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World*
Ayet: Let not the devil repel you; he is your most ardent enemy.

Pasaj Başlığı: Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World*
Ayet: When Jesus came with the miracles, he said, “I bring to you wisdom, and clarification of some matters in which you dispute. You shall reverence GOD and obey me.

Pasaj Başlığı: Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World*
Ayet: “GOD is my Lord and your Lord, you shall worship Him alone. This is the right path.”

Pasaj Başlığı: Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World*
Ayet: The parties disputed among themselves. Woe to those who transgressed from the retribution of a painful day.

Pasaj Başlığı: Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World*
Ayet: Are they waiting for the Hour to come to them suddenly when they least expect it?

Pasaj Başlığı: Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World*
Ayet: The close friends on that day will become enemies of one another, except for the righteous.
O My servants, you will suffer no fear on that day, nor will you grieve.
They believed in our revelations, and totally submitted.
Enter Paradise, together with your spouses, and rejoice.
Offered to them will be golden trays and cups of everything the hearts desire and the eyes wish for. You live therein forever.
Such is the Paradise that you inherit, in return for your works.
You will have in it all kinds of fruits, from which you eat.
Surely, the guilty will abide in the retribution of Gehenna forever.
Never will it be commuted for them; they will be confined therein.
It is not us who wronged them; it is they who wronged their own souls.
They will implore: “O Maalek, let your Lord finish us off.” He will say, “You are staying.
“We have given you the truth, but most of you hate the truth.”
Have they schemed a scheme? We too are scheming.
Do they think that we do not hear their secrets and conspiracies? Yes indeed; our messengers are with them, recording.
Proclaim: “If the Most Gracious did have a son, I would be the first to worship Him (anyway).”
Be He glorified; He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord with the great dominion, far above their claims.
Let them blunder and play until they meet their day that is awaiting them.
He is the only god in the heaven and the only god on earth, and He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.
Most Exalted is the One who possesses the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. With Him is the knowledge about the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.
None of those whom they idolize besides Him possess any power to intercede, unless their intercession coincides with the truth, and they are aware thereof.
If you asked them who created them, they would say, “GOD.” Why then did they deviate?
It is proclaimed: “O my Lord, these people do not believe.”
Disregard them and say, “Peace;” they will surely find out.
H. M.
And this profound scripture.
We have sent it down in a blessed night, in order to warn.
In it, every matter of wisdom is clear.
It is a predetermined command from us; we send messengers.
A mercy from your Lord. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; Have you attained certainty?
There is no other god besides Him. He controls life and death. Your Lore and the Lord of your forefathers.
Indeed, they are doubtful, heedless.
Therefore, watch for the day when the sky brings a profound smoke.*
Dipnot: *44:10 This prophecy takes place after the advent of God’s Messenger of the Covenant

Ayet: It will envelope the people; this is a painful retribution.
“Our Lord, relieve this retribution for us; we are believers.”
Now they remember! A manifest messenger had come to them.*
Dipnot: *44:13 For the specific identity of this messenger see Appendix 2.

Ayet: But they turned away from him, saying, “Well educated, but crazy!”
We will relieve the retribution for awhile; you will then revert.
The day we strike the big stroke, we will avenge.
We have tested before them the people of Pharaoh; an honorable messenger went to them.
Proclaiming: “Listen to me, servants of GOD. I am an honest messenger to you.”
And, “Do not rise up against GOD. I bring to you powerful proofs.
“I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
“If you do not wish to believe, then leave me alone.”
He then implored his Lord, “These are wicked people.”
Subsequently: “Travel with My servants during the night; you will be pursued.
“And cross the sea quickly; their troops will be drowned.”
They had to leave behind many gardens and springs.
And crops and an honorable position
And blessings that they enjoyed.
All were inherited by other people.
The heaven and the earth did not weep over them, and they were not respited.
Meanwhile, we saved the Children of Israel from humiliating persecution.
From Pharaoh; he was an oppressive tyrant.
We chose them from among all the people, knowingly.
And we showed them so many miracles, it was indeed a great test.
The present generations say,
“We only die once; we will never be resurrected!
“Bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful.”
Are they better than the people of Tubba‘ and others before them? We annihilated them for their crimes.
We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, just to play.
We created them for a specific purpose, but most of them do not know.
The Day of Decision awaits them all.
That is the day when no friend can help his friend in any way; no one can be helped.
Only those who attain mercy from GOD. He is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
Surely, the tree of bitterness—
will provide the food for the sinful.
Like lye, it will boil in the stomachs.
Like the boiling of hellish drinks.
Take him and throw him into the center of Hell.
Then pour upon his head the retribution of the Inferno.
“Taste this; you were so powerful, so honorable.”
This is what you used to doubt.
The righteous will be in a secure position.
Enjoying gardens and springs.
Wearing velvet and satin; close to each other.
We grant them beautiful spouses.
They receive therein all kinds of fruits, in perfect peace.
They never taste death therein, beyond the first death. He has spared them the retribution of Hell.
Such is the blessing from your Lord. Such is the great triumph.
We have thus clarified it in your language, that they may take heed.
Therefore, wait; they too are waiting.
H. M.
The revelation of this scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.
The heavens and the earth are full of signs for the believers.
Also in your creation, and the creation of all the animals, there are signs for people who are certain.

Also, the alternation of the night and the day, and the provision that GOD sends down from the sky to revive dead lands, and the manipulation of the winds; all these are signs for people who understand.
These are GOD’s revelations that we recite to you truthfully. In which Hadith other than GOD and His revelations do they believe?
Woe to every fabricator, guilty.
The one who hears GOD’s revelations recited to him, then insists arrogantly on his way, as if he never heard them. Promise him a painful retribution.
When he learns anything from our revelations, he mocks them. These have incurred a shameful retribution.
Awaiting them is Gehenna. Their earnings will not help them, nor the idols they set up besides GOD. They have incurred a terrible retribution.
This is a beacon, and those who disbelieve in these revelations of their Lord have incurred condemnation and a painful retribution.
GOD is the One who committed the sea in your service. The ships roam it in accordance with His command, that you may seek His bounties and become appreciative.
He committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth; all from Him. These are signs for people who reflect.
Tell those who believed to forgive those who do not expect the days of GOD. For He will fully pay the people for whatever they earn.
Whoever works righteousness does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. To your Lord you will be returned.
We have given the Children of Israel the scripture, wisdom, and prophethood, and provided them with good provisions, and we preferred them over all the other people.

And we gave them clear commandments. Ironically, they did not dispute until the knowledge came to them, due to jealousy amongst them. Surely, your Lord will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they disputed.
Then we appointed you to establish the law; you shall follow it, and do not follow the wishes of those who do not know.
They cannot help you at all against GOD. It is the transgressors who befriend one another, while GOD is the friend of the righteous.
These are enlightenments for the people, and guidance, and mercy for those who are certain.
Do those who worked evil expect that we will treat them in the same manner as those who believed and led a righteous life? Will their life and their death be the same? Wrong indeed is their judgment.
GOD created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose, in order to pay each soul for whatever it earned, without the least injustice.*
Dipnot: *45:22 God granted us this life as a precious chance to redeem ourselves, denounce our ancient alliance with Satan, and rejoin God’s kingdom. See Introduction & Appendix 7.

Ayet: Have you noted the one whose god is his ego? Consequently, GOD sends him astray, knowingly, and seals his hearing and his mind, and places a veil on his eyes. Who then can guide him, after such a decision by GOD? Would you not take heed?
They say, “We only live this life; we live and die and only time causes our death!” They have no sure knowledge about this; they only conjecture.
When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, their only argument is to say, “Bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful.”
Say, “GOD grants you life, then puts you to death, then He will summon you to the Day of Resurrection, which is inevitable. But most people do not know.”
To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. On the day when the Hour comes to pass, that is when the falsifiers lose.
And you will see every community kneeling. Every community will be called to witness their record. Today, you get paid for everything you had done.
This is our record; it utters the truth about you. For we were recording everything you did.
As for those who believed and worked righteousness, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. This is the great triumph.
As for those who disbelieved: “Were not My revelations recited to you, but you turned arrogant and were wicked people?”
And when it is proclaimed that GOD’s promise is the truth and the Hour is inevitable, you said, “We do not know what the Hour is! We are full of doubts about it; we have no certainty.”
The evils of their works will become obvious to them, and the very things they mocked will come back to haunt them.
It will be proclaimed: “Today we forget you, just as you forgot the meeting of this day. Your abode is the hellfire, and you will have no helpers.
“This is because you mocked and ridiculed GOD’s revelations, and were preoccupied with the first life.” Consequently, they will never exit therefrom, nor will they be excused.
To GOD belongs all praise; Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of the universe.
To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.
H. M.
The revelation of this scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, the Wise.
We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them except for a specific purpose, and for a finite interim. Those who disbelieved are totally oblivious to the warnings.

Say, “Consider the idols you set up besides GOD. Show me what on earth did they create. Do they own part of the heavens? Show me any other scripture, or any piece of knowledge that supports your idolatry, if you are truthful.”
Who is farther astray than those who idolize besides GO D idols that can never respond to them, until the Day of Resurrection, and are totally unaware of their worship?
And when the people are summoned (on the Day of Judgment), their idols will become their enemies, and will denounce their idolatry.*
Dipnot: *46:6 See also Matthew 7:21-23. Jesus clearly disowns those who call him “Lord. ”

Ayet: When our revelations were recited to them, clearly, those who disbelieved said of the truth that came to them, “This is obviously magic!”

When they say, “He fabricated this,” say, “If I fabricated this, then you cannot protect me from GOD. He is fully aware of everything you scheme. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”
Say, “I am not different from other messengers. I have no idea what will happen to me or to you. I only follow what is revealed to me. I am no more than a profound warner.”

Say, “What if it is from GOD and you disbelieved in it? A witness from the Children of Israel has borne witness to a similar phenomenon,* and he has believed, while you have turned arrogant. Surely, GOD does not guide the wicked people.”
Dipnot: *46:10 This witness is Rabbi Judah the Pious (11th Century A.D.), who discovered the same 19-based mathematical code in intact fragments of the scripture (see Appendix 1).

Ayet: Those who disbelieved said about those who believed, “If it were anything good, they would not have preceded us to it.” Because they were not guided thereby, they said, “This is an old fabrication!”
Before this, the book of Moses provided guidance and mercy. And this is a confirming Arabic scripture, to warn those who transgress, and to give good news to the righteous.
Surely, those who said, “Our Lord is GOD,” then led a righteous life, will have no fear, nor will they grieve.
They have deserved Paradise, where they abide forever; a reward for their works

We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him arduously, gave birth to him arduously, and took intimate care of him for thirty months. When he reaches maturity, and reaches the age of forty,* he should say, “My Lord, direct me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to work righteousness that pleases You. Let my children be righteous as well. I have repented to You; I am now a submitter (Muslim).”
Dipnot: *46:15 God knows full well who deserves to go to Heaven and who deserves to go to Hell. It is His law that whomever He puts to death before the age of 40 shall go to Heaven. God’s immense mercy is reflected in the fact that most people have difficulty accepting this divine mercy; they argue: “Put them all in Hell!” See Appendix 32.

Ayet: It is from these that we accept the righteous works, and overlook their sins. They have deserved Paradise. This is the truthful promise that is promised to them.

On the other hand, there is the one who says to his parents, “Woe to you; are you telling me that I will come back to life? How come all those before us never come back?” The parents cry for GOD’s help and say, “Woe to you; please believe! GOD’s promise is the truth.” He then says, “These are tales from the past.”
Such are the ones who are stamped as disbelievers in every generation of jinns and humans. They are losers.
They all attain the ranks they have deserved, in accordance with their works. He will pay them for their works, without the least injustice.

The day will come when those who disbelieved will be introduced to the hellfire: “You have wasted the good things given to you during your first life, and you rejoiced in them. Consequently, today you receive a shameful retribution as a requital for the arrogance you committed on earth without any basis, and for your evil works.”
Recall that the brother of ‘Aad warned his people at the dunes, the same warning delivered before him and after him: “You shall not worship except GOD. I fear for you the retribution of a great day.”
They said, “Did you come to divert us from our gods? We challenge you to bring (the retribution) you threaten, if you are truthful.”
He said, “The knowledge (about retribution) is with GOD. I only deliver to you what I was sent to deliver. However, I see that you people are unaware.”

When they saw the storm heading their way, they said, “This storm will bring to us much needed rain.” No, this is what you (challenged Hood to bring) -, violent wind wherein there is painful retribution.
It destroyed everything, as commanded by its Lord. By morning, nothing was seen standing except their homes We thus requite the guilty people.

We had established them in the same way as we established you, and provided them with hearing, eyes, and minds. But their hearing, eyes, and minds did not help them at all. This is because they decided to disregard GOD’s revelations, and the very things they ridiculed caused their doom.
We have annihilated many communities around you. We had explained the signs for them, that they might repent.
Why then did the idols they set up to bring them closer to GOD fail to help them? Indeed, they abandoned them. Such were their false gods; such was their own fabrication.
We directed a number of jinns to you, in order to hear the Quran. When they got there, they said, “Listen.” And when it was over, they rushed to their people, warning.*
Dipnot: *46:29 Jinns are the creatures who fully agreed with Satan when he initiated his famous blasphemy billions of years ago. They are brought into this world as descendants of Satan. One jinn is born every time a human being is born. The newly born jinn is assigned to the same body as the newly born human, and constantly pushes Satan’s point of view. When the human dies, the jinn companion is freed (Appendix 7).

Ayet: They said, “O our people, we have heard a book, revealed after Moses, that confirms all previous scriptures. It guides to the truth, and to a straight path.
“O our people, respond to the call of GOD, and believe in Him. He will then forgive your sins, and will spare you painful retribution.”
Whoever fails to respond to GOD’s call cannot escape, and will find no help against Him. They are far astray.
Do they not realize that GOD, who created the heavens and the earth and was never burdened by such creation, is able to revive the dead? Yes indeed. He is Omnipotent.

The day the disbelievers are introduced to the Hellfire, they will be asked, “Is this not the truth?” They will answer, “Yes indeed, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then suffer the retribution for your disbelief.”

Therefore, be patient like the messengers who possessed strength and practiced patience, and do not be in a hurry (to see the retribution coming) to them. The day they see it, it will seem as if they lasted one hour of the day. This is a proclamation: Is it not the wicked who are annihilated?
Those who disbelieved and repelled from the path of GOD, He nullifies their works.
While those who believed and worked righteousness, and believed in what was sent down to Muhammad—which is the truth from their Lord— He remits their sins, and blesses them with contentment.
This is because those who disbelieved are following falsehood, while those who believed are following the truth from their Lord. GOD thus cites the examples for the people.

Therefore, if you encounter (in war) those who disbelieved, you may strike their necks. If you take them as war captives you may set them free, or ransom them, until the war ends. Had GOD willed, He could have spared you such a war, and granted you victory. But He thus puts you to the test. As for those who get killed in the cause of GOD, He will not put their sacrifice to waste.
He will guide them, and bless them with contentment.
And will admit them into Paradise, that He made known to them.
O you who believe, if you support GOD, He will support you, and strengthen your foothold.
As for those who disbelieve, they incur misery; He causes their works to be utterly in vain.
This is because they hated what GOD revealed and, consequently, He nullifies their works.
Did they not roam the earth and see the consequences for those before them? GOD destroyed them, and the disbelievers will suffer a similar fate.
This is because GOD is the Lord of those who believe, while the disbelievers have no lord.
GOD admits those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. As for those who disbelieve, they live and eat like the animals eat, then end up in the hellfire.
Many a community was much stronger than the community that banished you; when we annihilated them, they had no helper.
Are those enlightened by their Lord the same as those whose evil works are adorned in their eyes, and they follow their own opinions?

The allegory of Paradise that is promised for the righteous is that it has rivers of unpolluted water, and rivers of milk whose taste never changes, and rivers of intoxicants—delicious for the drinkers—and rivers of strained honey. They have all kinds of fruits therein, and forgiveness from their Lord. (Are they better) or those who abide forever in the hellfire, and drink hellish water that tears up their intestines?
Some of them listen to you, then as soon as they leave they ask those who were enlightened, “What did he just say?” GOD thus seals their hearts and, consequently, they follow only their opinions.
As for those who are guided, He augments their guidance, and grants them their righteousness.
Are they waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? All the signs thereof have already come.* Once the Hour comes to them, how will they benefit from their message?
Dipnot: *47:18 The Quran, being the Final Testament provides all the signs needed to inform us that this world will come to an end in AD 2280. See Appendix 25 for the details.

Ayet: You shall know that there is no other god besides GOD, and ask forgiveness of your sins, and the sins of all believing men and women. GOD is fully aware of your decisions and your ultimate destiny.

Those who believed looked forward to any new revelation: “When will a new sura be revealed?” But when a straightforward sura was revealed, wherein fighting was mentioned, you would see those with doubts in their hearts looking as if death had already come to them. They were thus exposed.
Obedience and righteous utterances are expected of them. Thus, if mobilization is ever required, and they show their confidence in GOD, it will be better for them.
Is it your intention that as soon as you leave you will commit evil and mistreat your relatives?
It is these who incur a curse from GOD; He renders them deaf and blind.
Why do they not study the Quran carefully? Are their minds blocked?
Surely, those who slide back, after the guidance has been manifested to them, the devil has enticed them, and has misled them.
This is because they said to those who hated GOD’s revelations, “We agree with some of the things you say.” GOD fully knows their secret conspiracies.
How will it be for them when the angels put them to death? They will beat them on their faces and their rear ends.
This is because they followed what angered GOD and hated to please Him. Consequently, He has nullified their works.
Did those with doubts in their hearts think that GOD will not bring out their evil thoughts?
Had we willed, we could have exposed them for you, and you would have recognized them by certain marks. You can recognize them by their twisted utterances. GOD is fully aware of all your works.
We will certainly put you to the test, in order to distinguish the strivers among you, and those who steadfastly persevere. We must expose your true qualities.

Those who disbelieved and repelled from the path of GOD, and opposed the messenger after the guidance has been manifested for them, will never hurt GOD in the least. Instead, He nullifies their works.
O you who believe, you shall obey GOD, and obey the messenger. Otherwise, all your works will be in vain.
Those who disbelieved and repelled from the path of GOD, then died as disbelievers, GOD will never forgive them.
Therefore, do not waver and surrender in pursuit of peace. You are guaranteed victory, for GOD is with you, and will never waste your efforts.
This worldly life is no more than vanity and play. But if you believe and lead a righteous life, He will pay you, and not ask you for any money.
If He asked you for money, to the extent of creating a hardship for you, you might have become stingy, and your hidden evil would have been exposed.

You are invited to spend in the cause of GOD, but some of you turn stingy. The stingy are stingy towards their own souls. GOD is Rich, while you are poor. If you turn away, He will substitute other people in your place, and they will not be like you.
We granted you (O Messenger) a great victory.
For GOD has forgiven your past sins, as well as future sins, has perfected His blessings upon you, and has guided you in a straight path.
And GOD has supported you with profound support.

He is the One who placed contentment into the hearts of the believers, to augment more faith, in addition to their faith. To GOD belongs the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
He will surely admit the believing men and women into gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever, and will remit their sins. This is, in the sight of GOD, a great triumph.

And He will requite the hypocrite men and women and the idol worshiping men and women, for they have harbored evil thoughts about GOD. Evil will backfire against them. GOD is angry with them, condemns them, and has prepared for them Gehenna; a miserable destiny.
To GOD belongs the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
We have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner.
That you people may believe in GOD and His messenger, and reverence Him, and observe Him, and glorify Him, day and night.

Surely, those who pledge allegiance to you, are pledging allegiance to GOD. GOD s hand is above their hands. As for those who violate their pledge, they do so to their own detriment, and those who fulfill their pledge with GOD, He will grant them a great recompense.

The Arabs who stay behind will say, “We have been preoccupied with our money and our families, so ask forgiveness for us!” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Who will protect you from GOD, if He willed any adversity for you, pr if He willed any blessing for you?” Indeed, GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
You secretly believed that the messenger and the believers will never come back to their families, and this was affirmed into your hearts. You harbored evil thoughts, and turned into evil people.
If anyone refuses to believe in GOD and His messenger, we have prepared for the disbelievers a hellfire.
To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

Those who stay behind will say, when you are expected to collect spoils of war, “Let us follow you to share in this!” They wish to alter GOD’s commands. Say, “You will not follow us. This is GOD’s decision.” They will then say, “You must be envious of us (for staying behind).” Indeed, they rarely understood anything.

Say to the Arabs who stay behind, “You will be invited to face powerful people and fight them until they submit. If you obey, GOD will reward you with a generous recompense. But if you turn away as you did in the past, He will requite you with a painful retribution.”

The blind is not to be blamed, the crippled is not to be blamed, and the sick is not to be blamed. Whoever obeys GOD and His messenger, He will admit him into gardens with flowing streams. As for the one who turns away, He will requite him with a painful retribution.

GOD is pleased with the believers who pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts and, consequently, He blessed them with contentment, and rewarded them with an immediate victory.
Additionally, they gained many spoils GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

GOD has promised you many spoils that you will gain. Thus, He hastened such benefits for you in this life, withheld the people’s aggression against you, and rendered this a sign for the believers, in order to guide you in a straight path.
As for the group that you could not defeat, GOD took care of them; GOD is Omnipotent.
Indeed, if the disbelievers fought you, they would turn around and flee. They will have no Lord, nor a helper.
Such is GOD’s system throughout the past, and you will find that GOD’s system is never changeable.

He is the One who withheld their aggression against you, and withheld your aggression against them in the valley of Mecca, after He had granted you victory over them. GOD is fully Seer of everything you do.

They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and even prevented your offerings from reaching their destination. There were believing men and women (within the enemy camp) whom you did not know, and you were about to hurt them. GOD thus admits into His mercy whomever He wills, and requites those who disbelieve among them with a painful retribution.

While those who disbelieved were enraged, and their hearts were filled with the pride of the days of ignorance, GOD blessed His messenger and the believers with peaceful contentment, and directed them to uphold the word of righteousness. This is what they well deserved. GOD is fully aware of all things.

GOD has fulfilled His messenger’s truthful vision: “You will enter the Sacred Mosque, GOD willing, perfectly secure and you will cut your hair or shorten it (as you fulfill your pilgrimage rituals) there. You will not have any fear. Since He knew what you did not know, He has preceded this with an immediate victory.’
He is the One who sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all other religions. GOD suffices as a witness.*

Their example in the Gospel is like plants that grow taller and stronger, and please the farmers. He thus enrages the disbelievers. GOD promises those who believe and lead a righteous life forgiveness and a great recompense.
O you who believe, do not place your opinion above that of GOD and His messenger. You shall reverence GOD. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

Ayet: Surely, those who lower their voices at the messenger of GOD are the ones whose hearts are prepared by GOD to become righteous. They deserve forgiveness and a great recompense.
As for those who call on you from outside the walls, most of them do not understand.
Had they been patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
O you who believe, if a wicked person brings news to you, you shall first investigate, lest you commit injustice towards some people, out of ignorance, then become sorry for what you have done.

And know that when GOD’s messenger is in your midst, if he obeys you in many things, you will make everything more difficult for yourselves. But GO D made you love faith and adorned it in your hearts, and He made you abhor disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience. These are the guided ones.
Such is grace and blessings from GOD. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

If two groups of believers fought with each other, you shall reconcile them. If one group aggresses, you shall fight the aggressing group until they submit to GOD’s command. Once they submit, you shall reconcile the two groups equitably. You shall maintain justice; GOD loves those who are just.
The believers are brethren. You shall reconcile your brethren, and reverence GOD, that you may attain mercy.

O you who believe, no people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than they. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than they. Nor shall you mock one another, or make fun of your names. Evil indeed is the reversion to wickedness after attaining faith. Anyone who does not repent after this, these are the transgressors.

O you who believe, you shall avoid any suspicion, for even a little bit of suspicion is sinful. You shall not spy, nor shall you backbite one another; this is as abominable as eating the flesh of your dead brother. You certainly abhor this. You shall observe GOD. GOD is Redeemer, Most Merciful.

Ayet: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, “This is really strange.

Tall date palms, with clustered fruit.
Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.

Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.
Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.

At dawn, they prayed for forgiveness.

The earth is full of signs for those who are certain.

They visited him, saying, “Peace.” He said, “Peace to you, strangers!”
He asked his family to prepare a fat calf.
When he offered it to them, he remarked, “Do you not eat?”
He harbored fear of them. They said, “Have no fear,” and they gave good news of a knowledgeable son.
His wife was astonished. Noting her wrinkled face: “I am a sterile old woman.”
They said, “Thus said your Lord. He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.”
He said, “What are you up to, O messengers?”
They said, “We have been dispatched to criminal people.
“We will shower them with rocks of clay.
“Marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
We then delivered all the believers.
We did not find in it except one house of Muslims.
We set it up as a lesson for those who fear the painful retribution.
In Moses (there is a lesson). We sent him to Pharaoh with manifest signs.
But he turned away, in arrogance, and said, “Magician, or crazy.”
Consequently, we punished him and his troops. We threw them into the sea, and he is the one to blame.
In ‘Aad (there is a lesson). We sent upon them disastrous wind.
Anything that it came upon was utterly destroyed.
In Thamoud (there is a lesson). They were told, “Enjoy temporarily.”
They rebelled against the command of their Lord. Consequently, the lightning struck them as they looked.
They could never get up, nor were they helped.
And the people of Noah before that; they were wicked people.
We constructed the sky with our hands, and we will continue to expand it.
And we made the earth habitable; a perfect design.
We created a pair (male and female) of everything, that you may take heed.
You shall escape to GOD. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner.
Do not set up besides GOD any other god. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner.

You may disregard them; you cannot be blamed.
And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.
I did not create the jinns and the humans except to worship Me alone.
I need no provisions from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
GOD is the Provider, the Possessor of all power, the Supreme.
The transgressors have incurred the same fate as their previous counterparts; they should not challenge.
Woe to those who disbelieved from the day that is awaiting them.
Mt. Sinai.
The recorded scripture.
Published in books.
The frequented Shrine.
The exalted ceiling.
The sea that is set aflame.

No force in the universe can stop it.
The day will come when the sky will violently thunder.
The mountains will be wiped out.
Woe on that day to the disbelievers—
who are in their blundering, heedless.
They will be herded into Gehenna, forcibly.
This is the Fire in which you used to disbelieve.
Is this magic, or do you not see?
Suffer the burning. Whether you are patient or impatient, it will be the same for you. This is the just requital for what you did.
The righteous have deserved gardens and bliss.
They enjoy what their Lord has reserved for them; their Lord has spared them the retribution of Hell.
Eat and drink happily, in return for your works.
They relax on luxurious furnishings, and we match them with beautiful spouses.
For those who believed, and their children also followed them in belief, we will have their children join them. We never fail to reward them for any work. Every person is paid for what he did.
We will supply them with fruits and meats that they love.
They will enjoy drinks that are never polluted, and never sinful to drink.
Serving them will be servants like protected pearls.
They will meet each other and reminisce among themselves.
They will say, “We used to be kind and humble among our people.
“GOD has blessed us, and has spared us the agony of ill winds.
“We used to implore Him; He is the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”
You shall remind the people. With your Lord’s blessing’s upon you, you are neither a soothsayer, nor crazy.
They may say, “He is a poet; let us just wait until he is dead.”
Say, “Go on waiting; I will wait along with you.”
Is it their dreams that dictate their behavior, or are they naturally wicked?
Do they say, “He made it all up?” Instead, they are simply disbelievers.
Let them produce a Hadith like this, if they are truthful.
Were they created from nothing? Are they the creators?
Did they create the heavens and the earth? Indeed, they have no certainty.
Do they possess the treasures of your Lord? Are they in control?
Do they climb a ladder that enables them to listen? Let their listeners show their proof.

Are you asking them for any wage, and they are burdened thereby?

Do they have another god besides GOD? GOD be glorified, far above having partners.

Ayet: Then they saw a miracle; but they turned away and said, “Old magic.”
They disbelieved, followed their opinions, and adhered to their old traditions.
Sufficient warnings have been delivered to alert them.
Great wisdom; but all the warnings have been in vain.
Ignore them; the day will come when the caller will announce a terrible disaster.
With their eyes humiliated, they come out of the graves like scattered locusts.
As they respond to the caller, the disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult day.”
The people of Noah disbelieved before them. They disbelieved our servant and said, “Crazy!” He was persecuted.
He implored his Lord, “I am oppressed; grant me victory.”
We then opened the gates of the sky, pouring water.
And we caused springs to gush out of the earth. The waters met to effect a predetermined decision.
We carried him on a watercraft made of logs and ropes.
It ran under our watchful eyes; a reward for one who was rejected.
We have set it up as a lesson. Does any of you wish to learn?
How terrible was My retribution after the warnings!
We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
Aad disbelieved. Consequently, how terrible was My retribution after the warnings.
We sent upon them violent winds, on a day of continuous misery.
It tossed the people around as if they were decayed palm tree trunks.
How terrible was My retribution after the warnings!
We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
Thamoud rejected the warnings.
They said, “Shall we follow one of us; a human being? We will then go astray, then end up in Hell.
“Did the message come down to him, instead of us? He is a flagrant liar.”
They will find out tomorrow who the flagrant liar is.
We are sending the camel as a test for them. Watch them and be patient.
Inform them that the water shall be divided among them; (the camel) shall be allowed to drink on her designated day.
But they persuaded their friend to kill (the camel), and he obliged.
Consequently, how terrible was My retribution! They have been warned.
We sent upon them one blow, whereupon they became like harvested hay.
We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
We showered them with rocks. Only Lot’s family was saved at dawn.
We blessed him and his family; we thus reward the appreciative.
He warned them about our requital, but they ridiculed the warnings.
They negotiated with him about his guests; we blinded them. Suffer My retribution; you have been warned.
Early the next morning, a devastating retribution struck them.
Suffer My retribution; you have been warned.
We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
Pharaoh’s people were warned.
They rejected all our signs. Consequently, we requited them as an Almighty, Omnipotent should.
Are your disbelievers better than those disbelievers? Have you been absolved by the scripture?
Perhaps they think, “We will be the winners.”
All of them will be defeated; they will turn around and flee.
The Hour is awaiting them, and the Hour is far worse and more painful.
Certainly, the guilty are astray, and will end up in Hell.
They will be dragged into the hellfire, forcibly. Suffer the agony of retribution.
Everything we created is precisely measured.
Our commands are done within the blink of an eye.
We annihilated your counterparts. Does any of you wish to learn?
Everything they did is recorded in the scriptures.
Everything, small or large, is written down.
Surely, the righteous have deserved gardens and rivers.
In a position of honor, at an Omnipotent King.
The Most Gracious.
Teacher of the Quran.
Creator of the human beings.
He taught them how to distinguish.
The sun and the moon are perfectly calculated.
The stars and the trees prostrate.
He constructed the sky and established the law.
You shall not transgress the law.
You shall establish justice; do not violate the law.
He created the earth for all creatures
In it there are fruits, and date palms with their hanging fruit.*
Dipnot: *55:11 Compare the spaceship Earth's renewable systems and reproducing astronauts, with the most sophisticated spaceships that we launch into space. God be glorified.

Ayet: Also grains and the spices.

He created the human from aged clay, like the potter’s clay.
And created the jinns from blazing fire.
(O humans and jinns,) which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
Lord of the two easts and the two wests.

Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
He gave you ships that roam the sea like flags.
Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
Everyone on earth perishes.
Only the presence of your Lord lasts. Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?

Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?

Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
O you jinns and humans, if you can penetrate the outer limits of the heavens and the earth, go ahead and penetrate. You cannot penetrate without authorization.
Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
You get bombarded with projectiles of fire and metal, and you cannot win.
Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
When the sky disintegrates, and turns rose colored like paint.
Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
On that day, no human, nor a jinn, will be asked about his sins.
Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
(This is because) the guilty will be recognized by their looks; they will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.

This is Gehenna that the guilty used to deny.

Confined in the tents.

Which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?
Most exalted is the name of your Lord, Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
When the inevitable comes to pass.

The earth will be shaken up.
The mountains will be wiped out.
As if they never existed.

In the gardens of bliss.
Many from the first generations.

“Will be summoned to a meeting on a predetermined day.
“Then you, O disbelieving strayers.
“Will eat from the trees of bitterness.
“Filling your bellies therefrom.
“Then drinking on top of it hellish drinks.
“Then adding drinks of sand.”
Such is their share on the Day of Judgment.
We have created you, if you could only believe!
Have you noted the semen that you produce?

We have predetermined death for you. Nothing can stop us—
from substituting new generations in your place, and establishing what you do not know.

Have you noted the crops you reap?
Did you grow them, or did we?
If we will, we can turn it into hay. Then you will lament:
“We lost.
“We are deprived.”
Have you noted the water you drink?
Did you send it down from the clouds, or did we?
If we will, we can make it salty. You should be thankful.
Have you noted the fire you ignite?
Did you initiate its tree, or did we?
We rendered it a reminder, and a useful tool for the users.
You shall glorify the name of your Lord, the Great.

These uncountable decillions of heavenly bodies maintain their orbits in a divinely controlled precision. The more we learn, the more we realize how awesome this oath is. See Appendix 6.
